matches.d: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. WHAT YOU’LL DO Develop Mission Autonomy products that support the operation of Group 5 autonomous air vehicles Drive product development for the entire lifecycle from initial requirements development to fielding Define product roadmaps and timelines, guide cross-functional product decisions, and manage engineering risk Working closely with engineering leads and business development, evaluate trades to enable exploration of early designs Develop autonomy behavior and supporting product requirements. Collaborate with engineering teams to implement requirements Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, hardware engineers, test engineers, and program managers, to define test requirements and ensure alignment between system capabilities and mission objectives in complex operational scenarios Plan, execute, and analyze mission autonomy tests in simulated environments that replicate real-world scenarios to validate system performance and identify areas for improvement, iterating rapidly to refine autonomy behaviors and supporting products Support business development teams by being the product voice at the table with customers through customer briefings/demonstrations/exercises Support business development in creating and maintain updated presentation templates of product capabilities that can be used as an 80% solution for customer briefs REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Operational experience as a Pilot or CSO/NFO of USAF, USN, USMC 4th or 5 th generation fighter/bomber aircraft or RPAs Self-starter with high ownership, mission-oriented mentality. Desire to see the product meet the need of the end customer Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret test data, diagnose system behaviors, and recommend actionable improvements Organized and detail-oriented, with strong verbal & written communication skills Proven track record of working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project milestones and deliverables Experience in leading system design and development from initial concept through delivery to customers Ability to leverage operational experience and technical knowledge to make educated decisions and leverage engineering trades in the absence of clear customer requirements Willingness to work flexible hours. Up to 25% travel as required for customer engagements and product development activities Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance and experience with Special Access Programs PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 5th generation aircraft pilot experience preferred Weapons school instructor, weapons school graduate, test pilot school graduate, Developmental or Operational Test experience Bachelor’s degree in STEM, or equivalent experience in a relevant field Direct experience in the development, testing, and deployment of mission autonomy systems in a defense or aerospace context Familiarity with agile software development practices Knowledge of current industry and military standards related to unmanned aerial systems and their operation within national airspace Familiarity with the principles of mission autonomy, unmanned systems, and the integration of multiple assets into cohesive operational frameworks US Salary Range $166,000 — $220,000 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: Benefits At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits . Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com . Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. Data Privacy To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ . By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. matches.d: This is a remote position. The Agentic Growth & Value Transformation Lead owns Axiamatic implementation and onboarding end to end, carrying smaller accounts independently from kickoff through durable adoption. On larger, more complex engagements, this person partners closely with the Head of Agentic Growth and Value Transformation. The role sits at the center of the customer's first experience with Axiamatic 's agentic platform, translating business goals into configured agent solutions, driving those solutions to a first outcome as fast as the engagement allows, and then converting delivered work into demonstrated value that protects renewal and surfaces expansion. What You'll Do Implementation & Onboarding Execution Build the roadmap, objectives, and requirements with the customer during onboarding. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively across scope, timeline, and outcomes. Hold the customer accountable to the roadmap and commitments they've already agreed to. Set deadlines with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and manage configuration to requirements, validating output before go-live. •Manage Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) Build early momentum and sequence work to reach first value fast, without boiling the ocean. Value Realization & Expansion Ensure Axiamatic usage is on target to reach executives and/or stakeholders. Conduct quarterly service quality checks (QBRs) with stakeholders to ensure Axiamatic is providing value. Identify expansion opportunities and upsell areas (programs, business units, etc.) during delivery, partnering with the Account Executive. Proactively address adoption gaps before they become churn risks. Convert client wins into referenceable case studies and proof points. Requirements Manager-level (or equivalent) experience at a Big 4 consulting firm (EY, KPMG, PwC, or Deloitte) with 7+ years in Transformation, Digital Transformation, or a related delivery/advisory practice. ERP implementation / transformation experience (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, Workday) is a must, given the overlap with how enterprise customers approach large-scale program delivery. Managed 3+ full end-to-end ERP implementations and transformations. Comfort acting as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders, up to and including executives, on assigned accounts. Ability to translate a customer's business model and goals into concrete solution configuration and requirements. A track record of driving customers to measurable adoption and value outcomes, not just a completed implementation. Working fluency with (or aptitude to quickly learn) agentic/AI workflow tooling and the ability to explain its behavior and limits to non-technical stakeholders. Strong project management instincts: setting deadlines, managing scope, and holding both internal teams (e.g., FDEs) and customers accountable. A coachability and growth mindset: someone who actively seeks feedback, adapts as playbooks evolve, and shares reusable patterns with the team. Composure and sound judgment through ambiguity, escalations, and difficult customer moments. Growth Trajectory This role is a proving ground for delivery leadership. Strong performers will move into leading larger, higher-stakes engagements. Originally posted on Himalayas

matches.t: Business Owner, Agentic Contact Center Transformation
matches.why: High-impact AI agent transformation role at a favorite sector climate/energy company with strong compensation.
matches.d: About Carrier Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @ Carrier . About This Role This business- and technically accountable ownership role will focus on transforming the contact center into an agentic, Salesforce-native operating model. As a SAFe Business Owner, you hold primary accountability for ROI, solution fit, governance, and compliance for the contact center value stream. You define what needs to be built and why , make trade-off decisions across AI agents, human agents, channels, and integrations, and ensure delivery teams deliver outcomes—not just features. You will lead the shift from a traditional, human-centric service model to an agentic contact center on the Salesforce stack—where AI agents resolve work autonomously, escalate cleanly to humans with full context, and continuously improve using CRM + interaction data. Success is measured in containment, cost-to-serve, CSAT/NPS, FCR, AHT, and sustained adoption—not project on-time delivery alone. Key Responsibilities / What You Own: Agentic Contact Center Strategy & Outcomes Own the multi-year vision and value case for an agentic contact center on Salesforce (Agentforce / Agentforce Contact Center, Service Cloud, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, Data Cloud as applicable). Define target operating model: AI-first resolution, human-in-the-loop escalation, supervisor visibility, and continuous learning loops. Work with Contact Center Leadership to set and deploy KPIs (containment / deflection, AHT, FCR, CSAT, backlog, SLA, cost-per-contact) and the roadmap that moves them. Salesforce Service & Platform Steward Serve as the business/technical bridge for Salesforce Service capabilities supporting contact center transformation, including: Service Cloud case management, Omni-Channel routing/skills/queues Knowledge, macros, workflows/Flows, Service Console experience Voice / CTI patterns (Service Cloud Voice, Agentforce Voice, or telephony partner integrations such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, etc.) Agentforce Service Agents / agentic orchestration (topics, actions, grounding, guardrails, escalation) Data Cloud / CRM context used to power personalization and agent decisions Translate service operations needs into solution designs that prefer Salesforce OOTB and platform-native patterns before custom build. Partner with Solution Architects, Platform Admins, Developers, Data, Security, and vendors to validate designs, PoCs, and production readiness—while retaining ownership of business intent and acceptance of the solution. Ensure integrations (e.g., SAP order/billing/status, identity, telephony, knowledge sources, analytics) are designed for agentic workflows—not only human screen-pop use cases. Product Backlog, Prioritization & Value Delivery Own the contact center transformation backlog at the epic/feature level: prioritize for measurable service outcomes, not request volume. Define clear problem statements, solution hypotheses, acceptance criteria, and definition of done for agentic use cases (e.g., order status, returns, appointment setting, billing inquiries, warranty, technical triage). Sequence capability releases: channel by channel / intent by intent—from assisted AI → autonomous containment with safe escalation. Reject or reshape requests that are pure process workarounds, low-ROI customizations, or misaligned with the Salesforce target architecture. Operating Model, Governance & Adoption Establish governance for AI agents: topic ownership, action inventory, grounding/data access, Trust Layer / responsible AI controls, escalation rules, auditability, and human override. Partner with contact center operations, WFM, QA, training, and knowledge teams to redesign processes, scripts, QA scorecards, and coaching for AI + human collaboration. Drive change management focused on behavior and metric change (how supervisors and agents work), not tool rollout alone. Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, SDLC, and SAFe / Agile delivery practices. Required Qualifications: 5+ years in customer service / contact center digital platforms. 5+ years hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud in enterprise environments. Bachelor’s degree. Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated ownership of contact center technology transformation involving CRM + omnichannel + voice/digital channels (not just CRM case management enhancements). Practical experience designing or deploying AI-assisted or agentic service (Agentforce, Einstein bots / generative service, conversational AI, intelligent routing, or comparable enterprise agent platforms). Working fluency with Salesforce service architecture concepts: Omni-Channel, Flows, Knowledge, entitlement/case lifecycle, CTI/voice integration patterns, Experience Cloud / self-service (as relevant), and data/integration implications. Ability to evaluate build-vs-configure decisions, identify Salesforce OOTB fit vs. customization risk, and partner credibly with architects and engineers. Experience defining reporting/data requirements for contact center KPIs and using operational data to prioritize backlog (containment, AHT, FCR, CSAT, etc.). Familiarity with ERP/service process integrations (e.g., SAP order-to-cash / billing / status) sufficient to design end-to-end agentic journeys—not as a primary SAP functional consultant. SAFe Business Owner / Product Leadership Experience acting as (or equivalent to) a SAFe Business Owner, Product Manager, or Digital Product Owner for a complex value stream—accountable for ROI and solution outcomes, not only coordination. Comfortable leading PI Planning participation, prioritizing Features/Epics, accepting increments, and making risk/trade-off decisions live with delivery teams. Strong stakeholder leadership across Operations, IT, Architecture, Data, Security, and vendors—through influence and decision quality, not project control. Contact Center Domain Deep understanding of omnichannel service (voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service), workforce realities, escalation design, and QA/coaching impacts of automation. Proven ability to redesign service processes for automation-first resolution with safe human handoff. Hands-on experience with Agentforce , Agentforce Contact Center / Voice, Service Cloud Voice, or equivalent CCaaS + CRM unification programs. Salesforce certifications (Service Cloud Consultant, Administrator, AI Associate / Agentforce-related credentials) or equivalent demonstrable platform depth. Experience with Data Cloud, Prompt Builder, Einstein Trust Layer, or LLM grounding/guardrail patterns in production. Prior migration from legacy ACD/CCaaS or fragmented bot stacks onto Salesforce-centric service architecture. SAFe certification (SAFe Agilist / POPM) or demonstrated ART Business Owner experience. HVAC, manufacturing, distribution, or complex B2B/B2C service domain experience a plus. Education Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Operations, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree in platform and domain depth outweigh credentials . Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed. An exciting and challenging position exists as a Technical Program Manager at CoolIT. As a member of the Program Group, you would be accountable for the planning, development and launch of numerous new product introductions (NPI’s) What’s in it For You Health Benefits: Employer-provided benefits coverage begins on the first day of the month following your date of hire. Employees can choose from a selection of medicals plans , along with dental and vision coverage, with premiums shared between the employer and employee. Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance: Employee-paid Life and Accidental & Dismemberment (AD&D) coverage Disability Coverage: Employer-paid premiums for Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) coverage. 401(k) Retirement Plan : 2% employer-sponsored contribution. Paid Time Off: Three weeks of paid time off, six flex days, plus a one-week company-wide holiday shutdown. Professional Development: $1,000 annually to support professional development and continued learning. Work Environment: “Dress for Your Day” in a casual, professional workplace environment. Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment What You Will Do The Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the Program Core Team and serves as its battle captain, orchestrating cross-functional execution, technical integration, and accountability. Through deep technical understanding and risk-based decision-making, the TPM drives alignment, challenges assumptions, and ensures customer commitments are translated into successful outcomes. This will be a remote role and will be reporting to the Portfolio Manager based in Calgary, Canada. Lead the Program Core Team to drive from concept assessment, technical execution, cross-functional integration, customer alignment to NPI launch readiness and be accountable for the success of the overall program/project. Build strong customer relationships by understanding business objectives, technical needs, decision drivers, and success criteria; support the KAM in developing new business opportunities and preparing customer proposals. Collect, clarify, and translate customer requirements into product requirements, technical scope, PRDs, program plans, and measurable deliverables. Drive solution development with engineering teams by challenging assumptions, facilitating design trade-offs, resolving technical issues, and aligning decisions to customer commitments and program risks. Support DFMEA activities and broader technical risk assessments across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, supply chain, cost, schedule, and launch readiness. Develop and drive mitigation plans, escalation paths, recovery actions, and decision frameworks to protect customer commitments and launch outcomes. Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, sales, business stakeholders, and customers to maintain technical alignment, decision velocity, and execution discipline. Monitor program health through integrated schedules, dependencies, action registers, risk logs, budgets, and customer-facing status reporting in partnership with Project Managers. Travel globally up to 10%-20% to support customer relationship development, requirements reviews, technical reviews, supplier engagement, production readiness, and launch activities. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline, with strong grounding in mechanical, thermal, fluid, or electromechanical product development. 5+ years in technical program management, product development, systems engineering, or NPI execution for complex engineered products. Proven ability to manage customer relationships, understand customer needs, and translate requirements into PRDs, technical scope, and executable plans. matches.d: Integration meets Innovation At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world. We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Program Manager to strengthen alignment, execution, and operational discipline across Celigo’s product development organization. At Celigo, Product Operations empowers product teams to deliver high-impact solutions through clear operating models, strategic alignment, and scalable systems. We are evolving how we work - creating greater clarity from discovery through delivery and strengthening how teams collaborate to deliver measurable business value. As Product Development Program Manager, you will play a central role in operationalizing and reinforcing our product operating model. You’ll partner closely with Product Operations leadership to ensure teams move intentionally through the product lifecycle - from shaping opportunities to funded delivery and post-launch evaluation. This role is ideal for a seasoned program management professional who understands how modern SaaS product teams operate and enjoys bringing clarity to complexity. You’ll thrive if you’re energized by helping teams stay aligned, improving how work flows, and building trust through structure, communication, and follow-through. You will facilitate alignment sessions, coordinate readiness checkpoints, and support prioritization rhythms that keep work progressing predictably from discovery through delivery. You’ll connect people, processes, and tools - documenting decisions, tracking dependencies, and reinforcing accountability in a collaborative and supportive way. You won’t design the operating model - you’ll help bring it to life. Your impact will be visible in how seamlessly our teams operate, how confidently we commit, and how effectively we execute. What You’ll DoProgram & Alignment Leadership • Facilitate and operationalize key alignment sessions across the product lifecycle, including discovery alignment, triad syncs, Epic readiness reviews, and post-launch evaluations. • Prepare structured agendas aligned to the current stage of work and ensure each session results in clear decisions and next steps. • Proactively surface risks, dependencies, and misalignments early, coordinating across Product, Design, and Engineering to maintain momentum. • Ensure ideas, initiatives, epics, and stories move through the lifecycle in a consistent and intentional manner. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement • Provide visibility into overall initiative health across discovery, funded delivery, and post-launch impact. • Partner closely with Product Operations leadership to operationalize and reinforce the product operating model, identifying friction and strengthening execution discipline. • Support teams in consistently applying the defined lifecycle model, reinforcing clarity around expectations and sequencing. • Build and interpret dashboards and reports that reflect system health, translating insights into actions that improve focus and predictability. Stakeholder Management & communication • Build trusted relationships with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering Leads across domains. • Act as a unifying presence across teams, promoting clarity, alignment, and structured collaboration. • Provide concise, audience-appropriate updates to leadership, clearly highlighting risks, tradeoffs, and dependencies. • Model operational rigor and strong cross-functional coordination, helping elevate the maturity of the product organization. Who are we looking for? Skills & Abilities • Ability to facilitate cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design — particularly during ambiguity and early-stage shaping. • Skilled stakeholder manager who can influence without authority, build consensus, and diplomatically surface gaps. • Strong organizational discipline — meticulous in tracking decisions, risks, dependencies, and follow-through. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity clearly. Education & Experience • 5–10 years of experience in program or lifecycle management within a B2B SaaS product organization. • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field (or equivalent practical experience). • Strong understanding of modern product development practices (e.g., dual-track discovery & delivery, double-diamond, triad collaboration). • Solid grasp of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including discovery, funding alignment, delivery, and post-launch evaluation. • Hands-on experience with Jira and Jira Product Discovery. • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, cross-team initiatives in shared-resource environments. • Technical fluency in SaaS and web application environments; able to engage credibly with engineering and architecture discussions. • Experience operationalizing and strengthening product operating models within scaling organizations. • Experience working in environments with shared engineering pools and cross-team dependencies. • Experience supporting globally distributed product teams (e.g., US/India collaboration). • Familiarity with microservices or platform-based architectures. • Experience working within or closely alongside a Product Operations function. Who You Are • A natural systems thinker who brings clarity and structure to ambiguity without overcomplicating it. • Proactive and outcome-oriented — you don’t just track work, you improve how work flows. • A thoughtful communicator who keeps teams aligned, informed, and focused on what matters most. • Analytical and pragmatic — you anticipate risks, surface dependencies early, and address issues before they escalate. • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design. • Energized by helping teams operate with greater focus, discipline, and predictability. • Comfortable navigating fast-paced environments where structure and adaptability must coexist. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made. Celigo is proud to be • A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award. • Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year • Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management. • Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform. Here you'll experience • Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency • A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented • Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field • Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily • Competitive compensation and benefits, including: • Three weeks of vacation (starting year one) • Wellness days and holidays to recharge • Parental leave and a generous benefits package • Monthly tech stipend • Recognition and career development opportunities Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Engagement and Project Management · ~30% Runs the day-to-day of 16- to 24-week engagements, projects may run concurrently. Offering Build and Pilot Execution · ~25% Supports delivery of pilot offerings and helps shape what scaled offerings look like Support Business Development with offering-specific content and fit assessment during partner conversations Capture partner feedback and make recommendations on what should change in each offering to move from pilot to scaled offerings — phase length, data requirements, deliverable format, scope, etc. Document where an offering needs technology or data support and route as needed Convert what works into repeatable delivery assets: methodology documentation, deliverable and workplan templates, and enablement material for future delivery staff WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — FIRST 12 MONTHS Runs data collection, analysis, and deliverable creation without day-to-day direction All assigned projects completed within their contracted phase windows, with any extension attributable to partner-side issues rather than controllable delivery-side issues Recommendations are traced to a defensible, clinically- or operationally-grounded finding with solid financial implications outlined Physician and clinical stakeholders engage with the findings rather than dispute the data At least one offering materially revised — phase length, data requirements, or deliverable format — because of what execution revealed Brings a point of view to offering design and scaling discussions rather than only executing decisions made elsewhere Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS Required 3+ years in healthcare consulting or a related field, and 2–3+ years in an operational, quality, or performance improvement role within a health system Cardiovascular registry depth: STS Adult Cardiac Surgery Database, NCDR CathPCI Working knowledge of hospital clinical quality programs and registry data, or direct experience working with clinical quality or registry data Able to work in a pre-launch environment where the methodology is being built while it is being used Demonstrated ownership of the analytical core of client engagements — able to move from an incomplete data set to a defensible, quantified finding Strong project management: workplans, multi-stakeholder cadence, milestone tracking, and driving others to committed dates without formal authority Comfortable as the day-to-day partner contact with clinical and operational stakeholders Improvement Clinical, HIM, or CPHQ background Prior experience taking a service offering from pilot to repeatable delivery Project management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM) Total We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back. The Role We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program. Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers. matches.d: Business Area: Corp. Strategy Seniority Level: Mid-Senior level Job Description: At Cloudera , we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises. Job title: Manager, Applied AI Strategy and Operations Job Purpose: As a Manager, Applied AI Strategy and Operations within the Chief Business Officer and GM, Applied AI’s organization, you will lead high-impact, global commercial and operational initiatives with a direct emphasis on accelerating Cloudera 's Private AI growth. Our Applied AI organization is a fast-moving, dedicated group of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Industry & Applied AI Specialists, and business strategy leaders committed to establishing Cloudera as the trusted standard for Private AI in the enterprise. In this high-autonomy, high-trust role, you will act as the strategic and analytical backbone behind our field engineering motions. You will prioritize the right initiatives across our strategic accounts, establish robust governance and operating rhythms, conduct deep-dive portfolio and sales pipeline analyses, and synthesize complex technical and commercial signals into actionable recommendations for Cloudera 's senior leadership. Key responsibilities: Drive Global Governance & Operating Rhythms: Establish, evolve, and manage the programmatic operating rhythm for the global Applied AI organization across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Lead the monthly business review (MBR) process—from metric gathering and CRM ingestion through deep quantitative analysis and executive synthesis for senior leadership. Manage the AI Adoption Funnel: Partner with regional FDE and Applied AI Specialist leadership to track, analyze, and optimize customer progression through our four core execution stages: Discovery & Strategy, Solution & Value, Pilot & Prove, and Production & Scale. Account Prioritization & Use Case Frameworks: Structure analytical frameworks grounded in real customer signal—joining technical discovery sessions, reviewing triage outcomes, and working directly with field engineering teams to filter and isolate high-ROI Private AI workloads. Conduct rigorous analyses to down-select and prioritize target accounts across our Top 100 strategic enterprise lists. Define & Standardize Strategic Metrics: Collaborate with central Revenue Operations and AI GTM Sales Strategy to define, refine, and standardize key performance indicators around subscription and consumption-based Private AI adoption. Track organizational progress against critical milestones, including customer pitch meetings, on-site Use Case Workshops, Applied AI Hands-on Labs, and deployed production solutions. Ecosystem & Commercial Strategy: Analyze and support go-to-market operational alignment with major AI infrastructure and ecosystem partners (including NVIDIA Blueprints and VAST). Evaluate revenue share models, joint sales plays, and co-deployment strategies to maximize platform pull-through and annual recurring revenue (ARR) expansion. Cross-Functional Leadership & Solution Productization: Act as an embedded, highly trusted thought partner to technical and commercial leaders. Design and implement scalable processes for tracking team allocations and solution productization, ensuring repeatable delivery patterns are codified and communicated across Account Executives, Solution Engineers, and Professional Services globally. Business Planning & Executive Storytelling: Build comprehensive segment analyses, growth models, and strategic business cases to support critical investment decisions, headcount planning, and resource allocation across regional pods. Preferred Qualifications: Strong problem-solving and structuring skills, with a proven ability to scope complex, ambiguous strategic challenges and identify root causes within technical go-to-market organizations. Highly analytical and excellent at leveraging facts, CRM data, and customer insights to generate and validate strategic hypotheses regarding enterprise AI adoption and workload consumption. Proven ability to communicate and build trust with stakeholders at all levels—including C-suite executives, technical engineering leaders, and regional sales VPs—by turning granular data and research into actionable insight and a well-structured executive storyline. Deep familiarity with enterprise data management platforms, hybrid cloud architectures, data lakehouses (e.g., Apache Iceberg), and the broader AI/ML ecosystem capabilities. Strong quantitative, financial modeling, and data manipulation skills; proficiency in GTM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Clari), business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), and SQL is a strong plus. Demonstrated capacity to operate with high autonomy in dynamic, fast-moving environments, building structure and operational rigor from the ground up rather than inheriting legacy processes. Preferred Experience: 6+ years of progressive work experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, business operations, or management consulting, with a demonstrated track record of driving cross-functional alignment and measurable business impact. Direct experience supporting specialized technical sales, pre-sales, or post-sales delivery teams—particularly within Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Solution Architecture, or Applied AI Specialist organizations. Deep domain experience in enterprise software, big data analytics, machine learning/AI, or hybrid cloud infrastructure companies. Proven expertise working with cloud subscription, consumption-based (usage-driven), or product-led growth (PLG) business models, specifically tracking workload transition from pilot to production scale. Experience supporting enterprise commercial or technical organizations through rapid 2–3x+ revenue growth periods and global expansion across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. Note: Candidates without direct commercial ownership experience will still be strongly considered if they demonstrate long, deep tenure supporting commercial or technical sales leaders in a closely comparable enterprise GTM model. The right person in this role has an opportunity to make a huge impact at Cloudera and add value to our future decisions. If this position has piqued your interest and you have what we described - we invite you apply! This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is: Washington: $144,000 - $162,000 New York: $144,000 - $162,000 California: $144,000 - $162,000 Individual compensation within the published range is determined by the candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and primary work location. In addition to base pay, sales roles are eligible for Cloudera 's commission plan, while non-sales roles are eligible for the corporate incentive plan. matches.d: About Hostie Hostie is your restaurant’s Virtual Concierge, making sure every call, text, or question gets answered in your voice. Behind the scenes, we handle guest communication, reservations, events, and takeout automatically, all in one place. Hostie takes care of the noise so your staff can focus on the service. Restaurants across North America use Hostie to ensure no guest goes unanswered while giving their teams more time to focus on hospitality. Hostie integrates with platforms like OpenTable, Toast, and SevenRooms and is backed by Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI fund), Obvious Ventures (founded by Ev Williams), and leading hospitality investors. What You'll Do: GTM Strategy & Execution Build and iterate GTM playbooks - messaging, positioning, and launch processes that scale as we identify new product opportunities, new verticals, and new markets. Run competitive analysis and market research to inform how we build our positioning and messaging. Partner closely with sales and customer success to develop and test expansion and growth strategies. Investor & Board Strategy Own preparation for quarterly board meetings - pulling together materials, metrics, and narrative in partnership with the CEO. Field ad hoc investor requests and reports and support fundraising initiatives and investor communications as needed. Build business cases for new initiatives, partnerships, or investments. Business & Finance Operations Partner with Leadership on company priorities, strategic initiatives, and planning cycles. Identify operational gaps and help drive process improvements wherever something is manual, inconsistent, or breaking as we scale. Build and maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and KPI frameworks to track business performance. Support financial forecasting and modeling - helping build and maintain the models Leadership uses to plan headcount, revenue, and spend. Support billing reconciliation and help keep accounts payable running cleanly as we scale. We're Looking For: 2-5+ years of experience in strategy & operations or business operations, ideally in a high-growth tech or startup environment Background from top consulting, investment banking, or a strong business school foundation Analytically sharp instincts — you can build a model, read the data yourself, and don't wait for someone else to distill it A track record of owning something end-to-end, from strategy through execution, not just advising on it Exceptional curiosity and grit — you dig until you actually understand the problem Comfort operating in ambiguity — no one is handing you a playbook here Strong communication and writing ability — you can write a memo for the CEO and hold your own on a call with a merchant or investor A bias toward action and ownership — you'd rather test the hypothesis than write the memo about testing it Fluency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you actually work day to day — to move faster, not just polish emails Why Join Us: You'll gain direct exposure to the core functions of building a venture-backed startup: company strategy, GTM execution, operations, fundraising, and strategic partnerships — working alongside the CEO and Leadership Team from an early stage. A fast-growing market, and a chance to make a real impact: The restaurant technology space is expanding quickly, driven by rising demand for digital operations, reservations, and guest experience tools - and restaurants are under more pressure than ever to modernize. You'll join a lean, high-growth team where your work directly shapes how restaurants run better and where individual contributions have outsized impact on the business and the success of the customers we support. Collaborative environment: You'll receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you learn, grow, and achieve your personal/professional goals. What Else You Need to Know: The yearly total cash compensation for this role is $120k - $140k. Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and will vary depending on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package - full-time positions are also eligible for equity awards and benefits. Hostie is a remote-first company. Our HQ is in San Francisco, CA but our team is fully distributed with no onsite requirements. Originally posted on Himalayas

matches.d: Who We Are Everyday Electric (formerly Renew Home) is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America. We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort — and cleaner energy for everyone. We are an Equal Opportunity employer striving to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels that they have a voice that is heard. We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing. Role Summary Everyday Electric is hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the planning, execution, and operational health of complex, cross-functional programs across our VPP platform and consumer energy products. This role sits within the Technical Program Management team, reporting to the Director of Technical Program Management, and operates with significant independence to define how programs are structured, tracked, and delivered. This is not a coordination role. The TPM at this level is expected to build and own the frameworks that make execution reliable, communicate tradeoffs and risks in ways that drive decisions, and serve as an operational and technical thought partner to Engineering and Product leadership. Significant cross-functional situational awareness is required -- this person will regularly work across Engineering, Product, Design, Business Development, Customer Success, Grid Operations, and strategic planning functions. What You Will Do Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team programs spanning Engineering, Product, and Design, from scoping through launch and operational handoff. Define and maintain the planning frameworks, milestone structures, and risk models that enable predictable delivery across your programs -- not just track against plans others set. Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of cross-functional dependencies, blockers, and tradeoffs with clear recommendations, not just status updates. Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to set and pressure-test roadmap sequencing, resource assumptions, and launch readiness criteria. Drive programs through the full product lifecycle, with particular focus on launch readiness, post-launch metric validation, operational handoff to sustaining teams, and ensuring downstream stakeholders -- including Business Development, Customer Success, Grid Operations, and partner-facing functions -- are informed, equipped, and ready to operate before a program is formally closed. Develop and share operational practices and retrospective learnings that raise the execution standard across the broader TPM team. Serve as a decision-support resource for your stakeholders -- synthesizing technical and schedule complexity into clear options and tradeoffs for leadership. Maintain cross-functional situational awareness across interdependent programs, surfacing risks and misalignments before they become escalations. Requirements 7+ years of Technical Program Management or Engineering Program Management experience, with at least 3 years managing programs that span multiple engineering teams. Demonstrated ability to build or substantially improve program management systems and frameworks, not just operate within existing ones. Strong technical (software and/or hardware) foundation -- sufficient to pressure-test engineering estimates, understand architectural tradeoffs, and engage credibly with senior engineers. Track record of driving alignment across functions without formal authority, particularly in environments where priorities compete and stakeholders span technical and non-technical functions. Clear, direct communicator who can translate program complexity into executive-level narratives and decision points. Experience with consumer-facing software products. Preferred: Experience in energy, grid services, IoT, or related infrastructure-adjacent domains. Familiarity with VPP, demand response, or utility partner integration programs. Experience managing programs that involve external partners, device fleets, or regulated operational environments. Benefits What You'll Get A full-time position, with a competitive salary based on experience. The base salary for this role is $185k - $225k. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a target annual bonus of 20% of base salary, and participation in long-term incentive programs tied to company growth and performance. We use market data and consider your job family, background, skills, experience, and U.S. work location to determine compensation within our established pay range. Fully remote work environment with home office set-up allowance. Real and lived work-life balance - Company perks include no pre-set vacation limits (with a top-down culture of taking meaningful PTO every year!), parental leave benefits, and a corporate value of working sustainably and putting families first. Competitive benefits package that includes numerous health and wellness benefits. 401(k) plan, with employer contributions to the same. Opportunity to work with amazing people who are passionate about their mission, thriving in a fully-remote work environment, and learning and growing every day. At this time, Everyday Electric is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future immigration from the company, including training plans for foreign students. 2–5 years of experience in a product, business analysis, delivery, or technical role within a SaaS or technology environment Experience working with agile development teams and familiarity with Scrum or similar iterative delivery frameworks Demonstrated ability to translate business or product requirements into clear functional specifications or user stories Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, and Design Strong written and verbal communication skills WHAT SETS YOU APART? Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program. Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement. matches.d: What success looks like in this role: The rise of AI has caused a fundamental shift in the workplace. The organizations that lead this transition won’t win by doing the old job faster, they will win by embracing the change and rethinking the job entirely. Often, this work is split in two: giving people access to and training on the tools, and separately trying to manage the change. You'll support both halves of the problem: the curriculum that builds people's ability to know when and how to work with AI, and the operating model that turns that judgment into an adopted, governed, and measured practice across the organization. You’ll need to think both strategically and tactically. Some days present a high-level, multi-year strategy question; other days, it's working with one team on one workflow to figure out together what "working differently" means today. Both halves are held to the same bar: driving business impact and improving the daily lives of our employees. Key responsibilities: Define and deploy, globally. Map how the work is done today, end-to-end, pinpointing opportunities for AI integration across organizations (such as internal operations, client delivery, pre-sales, and product). Collaboratively define adoption and governance operating models. Help design the model, sponsorship, measurement, feedback loops, guardrails, as part of a broader team effort, and help drive how it runs while minimizing resistance and disruption. Drive AI fluency as a durable capability. Oversee the creation of scalable learning experiences that give people real judgment about delegation, discernment, and diligence with AI, model-agnostic. Support practical upskilling. Oversee the creation and/or curation of resources that ensure that people have the functional ability to leverage AI in the flow of work. Contribute to Unisys presales success. Shape custom Organizational Change Management (OCM) and training strategies that win client pursuits and ensure long-term adoption. Think strategically in terms of what the organization’s work might look like in five years, and also in terms of the specific exercise, workflow, or conversation that needs to happen now to move toward it. Measure behavior and prove it’s worth it. Define what changed practice looks like for each audience and tie adoption back to real business outcomes and to the actual work lives of the people doing the work. Stay ahead of the curve. Track how AI capabilities, tools, and norms are shifting over time, and revise curriculum and guardrails before they go stale. Provide change management support across various initiatives and projects and for broad segments of the organization. Drive processes to ensure key stakeholders understand the change implications associated with outcomes and deliverables. Identify and work with stakeholders to develop and implement strategies that help them thrive in continuous change. Ensure change enablement strategies and actions are incorporated into technology implementations and steady state operations. Play a key role helping to define and measure success metrics and monitor progress as well as business outcomes. You will be successful in this role if you have: BA/BS degree and 6-8 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience Prosci Certified Change Practitioner, or equivalent OCM certification preferred You may be a good fit if you: Have originated a team or function that didn't exist before. Have successfully deployed AI-forward initiates that drive transformation across an enterprise organization. Have built learning or enablement programs from scratch, at organizational scale that successfully changed behavior. Have a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams across a variety of functions and disciplines. Operate from a data-driven mindset, using analytical rigor to define success and translate outcome data into clear actionable insights. Are comfortable with ambiguity, understanding that real impact often involves pivoting based on the changing AI landscape and business needs. Strong candidates may also have: A strong background in instructional design, adult learning theory, change management, or organizational psychology. A proven track record of looking beyond conventional playbooks to uncover creative solutions to complex challenges. Unisys offers an outstanding benefits package, featuring unlimited paid time off, a 401(k) plan, comprehensive healthcare, HSA matching, ongoing learning opportunities, and more! We’re committed to supporting work-life balance and investing in your future success. At Unisys , we incorporate video interviews as a key part of our hiring process. This allows us to get to know you better and provide a more engaging and convenient interview experience. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to connecting with you virtually! matches.d: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s. About the role Most PMs at Tremendous run a squad. This role owns problems instead. We're growing fast and spinning up new product areas. Each one needs research, a roadmap, and shovel-ready specs before we staff it. That's your job. You'll dig into areas where we might launch a squad, and run projects too small to need one. You'll carry one or two projects at a time, drawn from the company's highest-priority open questions. When a problem proves worth solving, what happens next depends on how big the opportunity is. If it justifies a long-term team, you'll likely build that squad and lead it as its PM. If it's worth building but smaller, you'll build it yourself with an engineer or two and design help from a related squad. If it's small and close to an existing squad's work, you'll hand it off with a finished brief, and that squad's PM will carry it forward. You'll have real influence over new project areas and which teams exist a year from now. Today, the product management org is 7 PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product. You will Report to our Co-founder / Head of Product, Kapil Kale Own new product areas before they have a team. Develop a thesis, do the research, size the opportunity, and make a recommendation: spin up a squad, build it lean, hand it off, or kill it. Kill calls are as valuable as green lights. Turn research into shovel-ready work. Your output is briefs, prototypes, and specs that a squad can pick up and build immediately. Move quickly using AI. Use agents to dig through customer tickets, sales calls, usage data, and competitor research. Ship clickable prototypes in days to test ideas with real customers. Run projects that don't need a full squad. Some work is worth doing but too small for a team. You'll drive these end-to-end with engineers from existing squads. Cover a squad when needed. If a team is temporarily without a PM, you may step in. This is occasional, and your portfolio comes first. Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different. You have 6+ years building and shipping web applications as a designer, engineer, or product manager at tech companies, with at least 2 years taking new products from zero to one. Comfortable being the only person accountable for an initiative that doesn't have a team yet. Comfortable owning a portfolio instead of a single product. If validation kills your thesis, you move to the next bet without drama. A track record of turning ambiguous opportunities into prioritized, shovel-ready roadmaps. Strong product intuition, design judgment, and technical fluency. You hold your own with designers and engineers. Outstanding written communication. We're documentation-first, and this role runs on briefs and decision memos that need to persuade senior stakeholders. Founder, founding PM, or first-product-hire experience is a strong plus. What’s cool about the role Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $250,000 to $325,000. Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

matches.d: About Karbon Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. Karbon is further ahead on AI adoption than most companies our size. Every department is running AI daily. Hundreds of skills and workflows have been built by our own team. Fourteen department champions drive adoption and share knowledge across the business. The foundation is real and it works. The next phase is scale. We need one person whose entire job is extending what we have built, measuring what it returns, and adding the next layer of capability. Not a strategy deck. A working system, the governance that makes it trustworthy, and the numbers that prove it. You will report into the CEO and work across every department. You will have the access and sponsorship to make changes stick. About the Role Build the Tooling Ship internal automations and agents that remove repeated manual work across Sales, CS, Implementation, Support, and Operations. Connect AI to the systems we already run, through APIs and MCP servers. The first build is the data gateway. Karbon runs its own MCP server. You extend it into a routing proxy that sits between Claude and every internal data source teams need. Authentication via Okta. RBAC enforcement by department. Request logging for spend attribution and audit. Once the gateway is approved by Security, new connectors plug into a config entry instead of triggering a full review each time. That is your first thirty days. After that: CS gets a renewal risk signal. Sales gets a proposal draft automation. Implementation gets a SOW generator with scope-creep flags. Support gets a ticket triage router. Prototype fast. Harden what people use. Delete what they ignore. Hand every tool to an owner in the team that uses it. You build it. They run it. Own Governance and Visibility Manage the Claude access and provisioning workflow — seat requests, model and tool access, connector approvals — and the Slack workflows that support it. Run the connector security review pipeline in partnership with Security. Own the spend dashboard across all AI tools, not just Claude. Cursor, Codex, Linear AI, and anything else the org is running sit alongside Claude in one view. Department leaders see their own number weekly without asking you to pull it. Bad trends surface before they become invoice surprises. Extend that visibility into an ROI framework: adoption rate, hours saved, cost per seat, project-level impact. Partner with Finance on budget accountability. Run the AI champions program. Fourteen department champions, organized into pods, own peer enablement and skill submissions within their teams. You run the cadences, maintain the hub pages, and hold champions accountable for engagement. When people leave Karbon, their projects and skills do not leave with them. You own the offboarding flow that captures and reassigns that work. Build and maintain the AI wiki — per-department documentation of tools, active use cases, and skills in use. Keep it current as tools evolve. Train Teams and Set the Standard Work with each department lead to agree how their team uses AI, then hold that standard. Run practical training. Short, specific, and repeatable. Teach people the efficient way to get the same answer. Most cost problems are habit problems. After month one, you know what each team's workflows look like because you built them. That makes you a better trainer than anyone who has not. Build and maintain a shared library of prompts, skills, and patterns so knowledge stays when a person leaves. Own the pipeline that moves skills from intake through review to the shared library — and automate the parts of it that should not require a human. Measure and Report the Return Define the small set of metrics that show whether AI is working: cost, adoption, delivery, and quality. Build the data pipelines behind those metrics. Expect the source data to be messy. Publish a regular report to the executive team. Same format every time. Bad news included. Delete any metric that has not changed a decision in a quarter. About You! You shipped production software in the last two years, as the person writing the code. Python or TypeScript, SQL, and REST APIs. You built something real on top of a large language model. Not a demo. Something with users, error handling, and a cost you had to control. You worked directly with non-technical teams as the technical person in the room. Forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, GTM engineer, internal tools engineer, or similar. You know what a CS renewal motion looks like and what implementation scoping feels like. You do not need to have worked in those roles. You need to have built something those teams actually used. You can build a number out of messy data and defend it to a CFO. You have run a cross-functional program where the participants did not report to you — a champion network, an ambassador program, an adoption initiative. You know how to create accountability without authority. You write clearly, and you can say no to work that will not pay off. matches.d: Hi, I’m John and I’m the Head of Professional Services at Ashby. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles#8---implement-continuous-improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering, “How can we deliver a more impactful customer experience?”. That’s why I’m thrilled to be hiring for our new Solutions Consultant function! As a member of our growing Professional Services team (within Ashby’s Customer Success organization), you’ll have the opportunity to ensure customers have the technical support they need to fully optimize their use of Ashby, helping them build deeper integrations and more effective workflows. ABOUT THE ROLE This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Support — bridging deep technical acumen with strong customer-facing skills. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on complex product areas and integrations, working hands-on with customers via live engagements and expanding our team’s technical delivery capabilities. You’ll bring both product expertise and a consultative mindset, playing a critical role in implementations and integrations. WHAT YOU’LL DO: - Serve as a post-sales technical SME on complex product integrations, including enterprise identity and access management (IAM), workplace integrations, and custom APIs, supporting both internal teams and customers during implementations, early access product releases, and advanced configurations. - Lead customer-facing technical engagements, including discovery sessions, best practice consulting, and hands-on configuration of technical workflows. - Collaborate with Product to surface emerging technical pain points for exploration and stay ahead of new product capabilities that inform our customer engagements. - Enable our Technical Support team to focus on break/fix issues for existing configurations while you work upstream with customers to design and launch those configurations. - Execute solutions explored in pre-sales conversations to ensure continuity between customer expectations and delivered outcomes. - Translate technical depth into scale, converting insights and one-off solutions into documentation, playbooks, tooling, or enablement content for wider reuse when appropriate. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: - Customers receive enterprise-grade technical guidance and configuration support during implementation and post-live optimization activities - Ashby expands its customer offerings while enabling more effective specialization of responsibilities with cross-functional partners like Product and Support - Professional Services opens new revenue streams via defined technical services offerings - Technical workstreams operate collaboratively with core implementation workstreams and customer success motions - Custom solutions are documented and scaled for use with other customers YOU COULD BE GREAT FOR FIT IT YOU: - Are a technical generalist who can go deep quickly on topics like M365 and Google Workspace configurations and API-driven custom integrations. - Have prior experience as a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, Technical Implementation Specialist, or Product Manager, working with a complex SaaS product. - Can distill complex concepts for functional Talent Acquisition stakeholders (e.g., Recruiting Operations Managers), technical admins (e.g. HRIS or IT stakeholders), and executive decision-makers (e.g. VP of Talent). - Love live customer interaction, and enjoy solving problems in real time with users. - Thrive in ambiguity and are resourceful and self-directed — you’re excited to build the solution if it doesn’t yet exist. - Care deeply about product quality, clarity, and consistency — and want to help us raise the bar through every customer touchpoint. YOU MIGHT NOT BE A FIT IF: - You’re looking for a purely behind-the-scenes role with little customer interaction. - You prefer to specialize in a narrow technical domain rather than working across multiple feature sets. - You want strict role boundaries — this job blends technical depth with customer-facing work, and flexing between both is key. - You’re uncomfortable with ambiguity or iterative problem solving — this role often works in emerging areas without pre-defined solutions. - You rely heavily on handoffs or checklists — success here often requires defining and owning an issue end-to-end, even if it’s messy. OUR PHILOSOPHY Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell. - We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly. - We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. THE INTERVIEW At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety: - 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team - 45 min - Interview with Head of Professional Services (Hiring Manager) - Take Home Exercise (one week to complete) - 60 min - Interview with Integrations Consultant and Product Manager - Final Round: - 30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success - 30 min - Interview with CEO - 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. matches.d: Location & work modality: Remote Start: Asap Type of Contract: Freelance or Permanent About Radian Arc . Radian Arc delivers AI infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) solutions that enable enterprises, telecommunications operators, governments, and AI organizations to deploy, operate, and scale high-performance GPU infrastructure. With teams across the USA, Australia, Europe, Malaysia, Singapore, and Japan, we work with customers and strategic partners to deliver platforms for enterprise AI, sovereign AI, inference, training, and next-generation GPU cloud services. What impact you will have We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own complex, multi-stakeholder GPUaaS and AI infrastructure deployments from planning through production handover. You will set the plan, critical path, and delivery governance for each deployment. You will coordinate Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Product, Procurement, Data Center Operations, Service Delivery, Sales, customers, vendors, and strategic partners, and keep delivery aligned with customer expectations and commercial commitments. You will also play a key role in building Radian Arc 's Project Management Office (PMO). That means designing and standardizing how we deploy, and applying automation and AI-assisted development tools to turn those processes into repeatable workflows and live dashboards, with less manual coordination as deployment volume grows. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys creating structure in a fast-growing company. You will work with teams across the USA, Europe, Asia, and Australia, so you will regularly need to collaborate outside standard business hours. What you’ll do: Deployment Delivery Own end-to-end delivery of GPUaaS, AI infrastructure, hardware, and new data center / PoP deployments, from initial planning through production handover. Build and maintain the integrated deployment plan and critical path across all workstreams: scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, decisions, and completion criteria. Coordinate hardware procurement, site readiness, installation, networking, storage, compute, platform deployment, and customer onboarding across internal teams and external partners. Keep solution and engineering requirements, hardware delivery, site and operational readiness, customer commitments, and target production dates aligned. Lead deployment acceptance, go-live readiness, stabilization, and formal handover into Service Delivery and Operations. Manage multiple deployments in parallel, balancing shared resources, dependencies, and competing priorities. Deployment Process Design and Governance Define Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, required inputs, approval gates, and entry/exit criteria for each phase. Establish delivery governance, including project kickoffs, readiness reviews, change control, decision logs, and escalation paths. Create practical templates, checklists, and runbooks so new deployments start quickly and run consistently. Help build Radian Arc 's PMO by setting project-management standards and delivery disciplines that scale across customers, regions, and data center environments. Run post-deployment reviews and feed lessons learned back into the standard process. Automation, Dashboards, and Reporting Use AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Claude Code, to build, document, and continuously improve deployment workflows and project-management processes. Work with Engineering to connect deployment workflows to Radian Arc systems, tools, and data sources, and automate routine coordination, tracking, reporting, and data updates wherever practical. Build a standardized, shareable dashboard for each deployment, generated directly from workflow data so status is never maintained twice. Provide executive and working-level views of scope, procurement status, milestones, dependencies, blockers, decisions, owners, and next actions, as a single source of truth throughout the project lifecycle. Risk, Issues, and Stakeholder Communication Identify risks, blockers, resource constraints, and dependency conflicts early, and drive mitigation, escalation, and cross-team resolution. Provide clear, consistent status reporting to internal leadership, customers, vendors, and partners, and run regular project reviews, readiness reviews, and executive updates. Translate complex technical, operational, procurement, and delivery issues into concise updates, clear decisions, and actionable next steps. Build trusted relationships with customer, partner, and vendor stakeholders at both working and executive levels. What success looks like: In your first 90 days, you will: Own active deployments, with an integrated plan, critical path, and risk register in place for each. Document version 1 of Radian Arc 's standard deployment lifecycle, including stages, owners, gates, and completion criteria. Stand up a live dashboard for each active deployment that updates from workflow data rather than by hand. Within six months, you will: Have the standard deployment process in use across all new deployments. Have measurably reduced the manual effort spent on coordination, tracking, and status reporting What you'll need 7+ years in project management, program management, technical delivery, or infrastructure deployment roles, including 5+ years managing complex infrastructure deployments involving multiple internal teams, vendors, partners, and customers. 3+ years working with AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, cloud infrastructure, data centers, hardware deployments, telecommunications operators, or managed infrastructure services. A track record of owning deployments end to end, with direct responsibility for timelines, dependencies, and delivery outcomes, from hardware procurement and site readiness through go-live and handover to operations. Experience building or improving PMO processes, project governance, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and standardized delivery processes. Demonstrated ability to design and improve integrated project workflows, with a practical understanding of how automation, APIs, workflow tools, and AI-assisted development tools can reduce manual coordination and reporting. Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center, platform, and operational workstreams: enough to challenge a plan, spot a missing dependency, and earn engineers' trust. Excellent written and verbal communication, including with customers and executives. Experience working with distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones. Nice to have: Hands-on experience building workflow automation, integrations, or AI-assisted tooling using scripting, APIs, workflow platforms, Claude Code, or similar tools. Direct experience deploying GPU clusters or other high-performance compute environments. Experience with telecommunications operators, or with government or sovereign AI programs. Experience at a fast-growing company where you built delivery processes from scratch.
