Overview The Business Systems Analyst will support all areas of IT by understanding the diverse business need and product offerings, as well as the technology systems that support our business. This position will primarily focus on our customers’ business needs and offer products and/or solutions to meet those needs. Responsibilities Working with customers and/or business stakeholders to accurately capture business requirements for new projects and customer onboarding Work with IT team members to review and clarify requirements as needed and act as the liaison between business project stakeholders and IT Responsible for technical documentation of system components and processes Maintains and manages customer service requests that are routed via our Service Desk Manages and monitors existing functionalities and defines new functionality as needed for application integrity Interfaces with internal and external technical staff to define application solutions and resolve problems as needed Manage incident workflow from initial reporting to final resolution including incident handoffs with outsourced 3rd party organizations Collaborate with IT to develop detailed project specifications Conduct testing and deliver training related material for new customer IT enhancements Contribute to a knowledge base of known problems and resolutions for customers and sales to resolve problems on their own Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. matches.why: Good match for candidate's cross-functional technical project delivery, customer onboarding, and systems coordination background.
matches.d: Role Summary Ciroos is hiring a Technical Customer Success / Customer Program Manager to own the customer program from onboarding through adoption — connecting the dots across the customer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering. This is a role for someone who knows how to drive: you'll know what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, what needs to be prioritized, and what comes next to keep the customer moving forward. You'll be the person making sure things don't fall through the cracks. You need enough technical depth to be comfortable working with SRE, observability, cloud, infrastructure, integrations, and enterprise IT teams — but you are not expected to be the FDE building everything yourself. Your job is to make the entire program move. What You'll Do Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Orchestration Own the customer program end-to-end from onboarding through adoption, tracking what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, and what to prioritize next. Drive accountability across teams: when Engineering owes something, you drive it to closure; when Product needs to make a decision, you get it in front of them; when priorities compete, you help create clarity. Coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder technical deliverables to a clean finish — for example, driving an enterprise security questionnaire (such as a Splunk-integration review covering data retention, permissions, token encryption, and incident response) from a draft with open “pending engineering confirmation” items to a fully-owned, sign-off-ready response, assigning clear owners and chasing each item to closure. Maintain a single source of truth on program status — open items, owners, and dates — so nothing depends on memory or gets lost between Slack threads, docs, and meetings. Customer Relationship & Value Delivery Build strong relationships with customers, understand what success looks like for them, and keep them engaged throughout onboarding and adoption. When the customer is waiting, make sure they always know exactly where things stand — proactive, clear, and specific status, not “checking on it.” Make sure Ciroos is delivering measurable value against what the customer actually cares about, not just what was scoped at kickoff. Technical Fluency & Escalation Support Engage credibly with customer SRE, observability, cloud/infrastructure, security, and enterprise IT stakeholders — understanding enough of the technical substance (integrations, permissions, data handling, deployment mechanics) to keep a conversation moving without needing to build the solution yourself. Partner with FDE and Engineering on technical questions, security/compliance reviews, and integration asks that surface mid-program, translating between customer language and internal owners in both directions. Flag risk early — a stalled dependency, an unanswered question, an unclear owner — before it becomes a customer-visible problem. What We're Looking For Experience leading complex enterprise customer programs — technical customer success, customer/program/project management, TAM, or solutions delivery — with a track record of driving multi-team initiatives to completion. A natural “what's next, who owns it, and when will it be done” operator: organized, persistent, and comfortable creating structure in a fast-moving startup environment without waiting to be told. Enough technical curiosity and depth to be comfortable in conversations spanning SRE, observability, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, integrations (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, ServiceNow), and enterprise security/compliance reviews. Excellent written and verbal communication — able to represent status clearly to customers and internally, and to get concise, unambiguous commitments out of Engineering and Product. Customer-focused and relationship-driven, with the judgment to balance advocating for the customer with realistic internal prioritization. Nice to Have Experience managing programs for large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers, where multiple stakeholders (security, IT, SRE, procurement, legal) and layers of internal approval are the norm, not the exception. Background working alongside SRE, DevOps, or observability teams, or prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering, or technical account management function. Experience at an early-stage startup, including comfort with ambiguity and building process rather than inheriting it. Familiarity with ITSM and collaboration tooling (ServiceNow, Slack, Jira/Linear) used to run customer programs day to day. What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months) Every active customer program has a clear, current picture of status, owners, and next steps — available at any moment without a scramble. Cross-functional blockers get resolved in days, not weeks, because you know exactly who to go to and how to get a decision made. Customers describe you as their go-to point of contact — someone who keeps them informed and consistently follows through. Complex technical deliverables that touch multiple teams (security reviews, integration sign-offs, onboarding milestones) close out cleanly, with nothing left pending indefinitely. You've built lightweight process — trackers, templates, cadences — that make the next customer program easier to run than the last. About Ciroos Ciroos (pronounced "Sai rose") is a seed-stage startup founded in February 2025 by experienced executives and distinguished engineers with deep expertise in observability, AI, distributed systems, cloud, cybersecurity, and networking. Our mission is to provide an AI SRE Teammate that empowers SREs to be superheroes — a multi-agentic AI platform that uses expert human-like reasoning to decrease toil, investigate incidents faster, and drive autonomous operations. We’ve raised $21M in seed funding led by Energy Impact Partners and prominent angel investors. We’re headquartered in Pleasanton, CA with growing operations in India. Why Work at Ciroos ? We dream big and execute fast. Build. Test. Iterate — all at lightning speed in service of our customers. Our "BEST" perks: Benefits : Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental benefits, plus meals and snacks in-office. Equity : Meaningful equity — real ownership, not just a nice line on paper. Stewardship : A high-impact role with mentorship from founders and senior engineers. Teamwork : High-IQ, high-EQ coworkers. No politics. No bureaucracy. No permission-seeking. GTI Energy embraces a vision for integrated, low-carbon, low-cost energy systems that leverage gases, liquids, efficiency, and infrastructure to meet the urgent challenges presented by climate change and global energy access. With a team that includes some of the nation's top energy scientists, engineers, and thought leaders, we are helping deliver clean and resilient solutions to a growing world. GTI Energy partners with organizations around the globe to operationalize the ambitious aspirations required for the global energy transition. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Project Manager to join our project management team. This position will perform project management functions with a team of engineers, scientists, for projects in research, demonstration, or development of new technologies. Project managers at GTI Energy typically manage several projects simultaneously, which gives them exposure to multiple technologies, customers, and internal groups. Why GTI Energy ? GTI Energy is where complex energy challenges meet bold solutions. With deep expertise in energy research, technology development, and business innovation, we help partners across industries build and demonstrate solutions for better-performing energy systems. Our progress is guided by collaboration, innovation, and systems thinking. Joining GTI Energy means being part of a purpose-driven team motivated by learning, growing, and making an impact. We offer competitive compensation, strong benefits, and opportunities for professional development in a culture that values respect and belonging. Recognized as a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for seven consecutive years, our people-focused culture reflects our commitment to creating an environment where people feel supported, valued, and able to thrive. A high-level overview is available at: 2026 Benefits at Glance GTI Energy . Work Location This position is California-based and will be fully remote. Periodic domestic travel may be required several weeks per year during normal work weekdays. Primary Responsibilities Detailed project management on large or complex projects to include budget management, project scoping , customer interactions, overseeing contractual execution and compliance , presenting, and report writing. Ensure all reporting requirements to Federal Government Agencies and State Agencies (e.g., California Energy Commission) are met on a timely basis. Generate, maintain and execute, in cooperation with all parties, a detailed Risk Management Plan . Communicate effectively with project teams to gather and provide essential information that contributes to project success, including scope management, budget adherence, and schedule compliance. matches.d: Who Are We? We at Movemedical make the world’s best software solution for medical device companies. We're hiring a Senior Project Manager to own delivery of our strategic enterprise implementation programs for our medical device customer organizations. You’ll join our Professional Services team, working closely with our VP of Professional Services and Chief Customer Officer, with ownership over how these programs get run from day one. We hire smart, tenacious people and give them the mentorship and opportunities they need to grow as team members and leaders. As a small company with big ambitions, we see and recognize the impact of every person on our team. We are team-oriented and want each other to be successful; we pull together to accomplish our goals. Glassdoor gives us a 4.2/5.0 and Inc. put us on its Best Places to Work Editor’s List in 2019. Who Are You? You've either worked as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, run large ERP or supply-chain implementations, or led enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. Either way, you speak the language of the clients we serve, and you bring real rigor to how you manage a program. You’ve also worked somewhere fast-moving and not fully formal, and you know how to adapt your process to fit rather than importing a rigid framework. You don’t wait for internal clarity before acting with confidence. You hold the line on scope, timeline, and rigor with clients and with your own team, even while the environment around you is still being defined. You’re comfortable being the senior voice in the room with a client, and just as comfortable pushing back internally when something isn’t set up to succeed. When a program starts heading toward real trouble, whether budget, timeline, or scope, you know when to handle it yourself and when to bring it to your manager, and you don’t wait until it’s unavoidable. What Success Looks Like Programs that run like clockwork: you own delivery of your assigned enterprise client implementations end-to-end, covering scoping, timeline, and risk and issue tracking, with a level of structure and status-reporting discipline that holds up under real scrutiny from clinical and med device clients. A confident, credible presence: clients and internal teams see you as someone who can hold the line on scope, timeline, and rigor, even before every internal process is fully defined. You don’t wait for top-down clarity to act. Process oriented approach: you’ve adapted PM process and status-reporting cadence to fit Movemedical ’s actual pace and stage, building something repeatable rather than importing a framework wholesale, so the rigor doesn’t depend on any one person’s habits. Judgment under pressure: you’ve correctly judged when a real risk needed to go to your manager versus being handled independently, and you’ve stayed effective through sustained ambiguity or internal politics without disengaging. Trusted by clients and colleagues alike: you’ve built genuine credibility with med device and clinical client stakeholders, translating product and technical reality into plans they can trust, even when things weren’t going smoothly. What will you do? You will own end-to-end delivery of assigned client implementation programs, from kickoff through go-live You will run and maintain program status reporting, timelines, and risk/issue tracking, communicating clearly with both client and internal stakeholders You will act as the primary point of contact for client program stakeholders, representing Movemedical with the rigor and professionalism expected by med device and clinical organizations You will coordinate cross-functionally with Professional Services, Support, and Product teams to keep implementations on track You will build enough fluency in client-side technical and operational context, including inventory, supply chain, and clinical workflows, to be seen as credible by client stakeholders You will escalate risks and blockers proactively and assertively, both internally and with clients, without waiting for permission You will contribute to maturing Movemedical ’s overall PM process and standards over time What skills and experience do we expect you to have? Experience as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, running large ERP / supply-chain implementations (e.g., SAP), or leading enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. Industry exposure is valued, not required. A track record of running complex, multi-stakeholder implementation programs end-to-end, with real scoping, timeline, and risk-tracking discipline Demonstrated ability to adapt a PM process you know well to a faster-moving, less formal environment, rather than importing it wholesale Comfortable holding a position and pushing back, whether with clients or with your own leadership, even under ambiguity or pressure Strong written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to escalate a risk and when to handle it yourself You're comfortable traveling up to approximately 25% of the time, as needed, to support client engagements Is this the right role for you? This is likely a strong fit if: You’ve worked inside a medical device, clinical, or complex enterprise-implementation environment (SAP or similar) and speak that world fluently You’d rather adapt your process to a fast-moving company than import a playbook wholesale from a more structured one You hold your ground with clients and with your own leadership, and you’re comfortable acting before every detail is settled You want real ownership of programs from day one, not a process someone else already built It may be less of a fit if: You do your best work when a company already has a mature, well-established process to step into, and you're less drawn to learning the operational ins and outs of medical device or clinical client environments. This role leans heavily on that operational fluency alongside the PM mechanics, so if you'd rather focus purely on the mechanics of the job, it's probably not where you'll do your best work. You prefer a fully defined framework and a larger team to lean on before making a call You are looking for a people-management role. This one has no direct reports today What Character Traits Do We Value? Hungry – You own problems and push beyond expectations without being asked Humble – You value team success over ego and foster shared wins Strong – You are self-aware, coachable, and willing to engage in hard conversations What Do We Offer? Great People: Join a team of hungry, humble, and strong problem solvers dedicated to impacting patient lives around the world. Benefits: Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision), Wellness Programs, 401k, Flexible PTO Remote-first Culture: Featured in Inc.'s Best Places to Work Editor's List with a 4.3/5.0 Glassdoor score Other Perks: Stipends for fitness activities, snacks, and your at-home workspace 💵 Compensation The base salary for this role ranges from $120,000 to $160,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications. 📍 Location Remote (US-based) This position is fully remote; however, we are only able to consider candidates currently located within the United States. matches.d: Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr ’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description About the Role This role sits within Sprinklr 's Professional Services organization and is a hybrid Implementation Consultant and Managed Services Consultant position focused on Sprinklr CCaaS solutions. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable leading new customer implementations and providing strategic post-go-live consulting and optimization services. You will partner with customers throughout their entire lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through implementation, adoption, expansion, and ongoing optimization. Success in this role requires a strong blend of business consulting, technical delivery, platform configuration, and customer engagement expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience implementing and supporting enterprise CCaaS platforms, including voice, digital channels, conversational AI, chatbots, IVR, routing, automation, and customer journey orchestration. You understand how to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and can advise customers on best practices to maximize business outcomes. What You'll Do Work as part of a cross-functional team consisting of Implementation Consultants, Technical Consultants, Project Managers, Product Engineers, Solutions Consultants, Customer Success Managers, and Managed Services teams to deploy and optimize the Sprinklr platform. Lead the full lifecycle of customer engagements, including discovery, business analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live optimization. Design, configure, and maintain CCaaS solutions including voice, digital channels, chatbots, conversational AI, routing strategies, automation workflows, and customer journey experiences. Act as a trusted advisor to customers, providing both implementation expertise and ongoing managed services guidance to drive adoption and business value. Translate customer business processes and requirements into scalable Sprinklr platform solutions. Identify platform optimization opportunities and recommend enhancements aligned to business objectives. Partner with Project Managers across multiple engagements to ensure successful delivery, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of project milestones. Troubleshoot complex business and technical use cases in partnership with Product and Engineering teams. Provide customer enablement, training, and operational best practices to drive long-term success. Support change requests, platform enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives for existing customers post deployment. Transition implementation projects into ongoing managed services engagements while documenting architecture, business requirements, and future recommendations. Assist Services Managers with solution scoping, effort estimation, and proposal development for prospective customers. Travel on-site with customers as needed. Who You Are & What Makes You Qualified Must Have Fluent in English, written and verbal. 5+ years of experience in enterprise CCaaS implementation, managed services, technology consulting, or professional services delivery. Strong experience implementing and supporting cloud contact center technologies. Deep understanding of contact center operations, voice technologies, omnichannel customer service, IVR, routing, workforce optimization, automation, and conversational AI. Hands-on experience configuring and managing CCaaS platforms such as Sprinklr , Genesys, Amazon Connect, Talkdesk, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Five9, Twilio Flex, RingCentral, Avaya, or similar technologies. Strong technical configuration and systems administration experience with the ability to troubleshoot complex customer requirements. Experience implementing AI-powered customer support solutions, chatbots, virtual agents, and voice automation capabilities. Proven ability to understand customer business challenges and translate requirements into scalable platform solutions. Experience facilitating customer workshops, requirements gathering sessions, training, and executive-level presentations. Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and customer-facing communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and customer engagements simultaneously. Passion for solving complex business and technical challenges with a commitment to customer success. Nice to Have Experience supporting both implementation and post-go-live managed services engagements. Experience with cloud architecture, VoIP, SIP, telephony, APIs, and integrations. Sprinklr platform experience or experience with a competing CCaaS/CXM platform. Experience implementing AI, chatbot, workforce management, or customer journey orchestration solutions. Experience with Care, Research, Sales, Marketing, Advertising, or broader CXM SaaS platforms. Relevant contact center and cloud certifications. Ideal Candidate Profile The strongest candidate is someone who can seamlessly move between solution consulting, technical configuration, implementation delivery, and ongoing managed services support. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. matches.d: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About the Role: Reporting to the VP Strategy, the Market Activation Analyst for Health Plans & Health Systems (HP/HS) will serve as the analytical engine driving strategic geographic expansion, market entry, and commercial activation. This role bridges macro-level healthcare market intelligence with tactical target setting to optimize commercial growth and care delivery scaling. The ideal candidate possesses deep quantitative rigour, experience working with third-party healthcare datasets, and the ability to turn complex market dynamics into executable, provider-level and payer-level activation playbooks. Responsibilities Macro Market Analysis & Expansion Strategy Leverage third-party healthcare data platforms and analytical tools (e.g., claims data, census/demographic data, payer landscape analysis) to conduct macro-level market evaluations. Synthesize complex market trends to inform the corporate roadmap and establish data-driven strategic rationales for future geographic expansion and payer contracting priorities. Evaluate payer density, reimbursement models, and local healthcare regulations to identify high-value market entry opportunities. Playbook Customization & Tactical Prioritization Develop and customize market-specific activation playbooks with directional prioritization of target provider groups, health systems, and specialty service lines. Conduct strategic profiling and market-level competitive analysis to pinpoint high-potential clinical partners and network integration opportunities. Partner with cross-functional commercial, clinical operations, and business development teams to tailor market go-to-market strategies based on local competitive dynamics. Funnel Modeling & Target Setting Refine, maintain, and own the market activation Top-of-Funnel (TOFU) and Care Starts quantitative models that drive company-wide target-setting. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across activation stages—from initial market entry and provider outreach through to patient onboarding and active care starts. Iterate forecast models using empirical performance data to optimize lead generation, funnel efficiency, and revenue predictability per market. Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, or market intelligence within a digital health, health plan, health system, or high-growth healthtech organization. Data & Analytical Skills: Advanced quantitative and analytical skills (Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, or BI tools like Tableau/Looker) with proven experience structuring and manipulating large third-party datasets (e.g., IQVIA, Definitely Health, CMS/claims data). Strategic & Funnel Modeling: Direct experience building and maintaining conversion, pipeline, or top-of-funnel operational models (e.g., lead-to-care start funnels). Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of US healthcare delivery models, health plan reimbursement structures, health system operations, and provider profiling. Communication: Strong narrative synthesis and slide-building abilities to translate dense market data into clear, actionable executive playbooks. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles. As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards. You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready. Key Responsibilities 1. PMO Reporting & Project Standards PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines. Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks. Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy. Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth. 2. Hybrid Project Management & Governance Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows. Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks. Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap. Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness. 3. Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently. Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations. Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring. 4. Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews. Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards. Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives. Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking. 5. SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits. Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria. Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking. Required Qualifications & Experience Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment. PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks. Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams. Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation. Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira. Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks. Preferred Qualifications Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards. Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials. Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering. matches.d: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We are committed to making pharmacy benefits easy to understand, straightforward to access and always in the best interest of employers and the lives they impact. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizing state-of-the-art technology. Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always. Position Summary: The Business Analyst, Data Operations is the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and AffirmedRx’s business-facing teams, particularly Client Management and Patient Care Advocates. Reporting to the Manager, Data Operations. This individual is the first point of contact when a client manager or patient care advocate identifies a file-related or data issue: gathering the details needed to understand it, conducting impact analysis to determine its scope and severity, and keeping every involved party informed of status from the moment an issue is reported through resolution. This role maintains a dashboard or similar tracking tool as the single source of truth on open issues and is expected to communicate proactively — no one should have to ask for a status update. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential, since this individual routinely translates between technical data operations work and the business teams who depend on it. What you will do: Issue Intake and Triage: Serve as the primary point of contact for client managers and patient care advocates reporting file-related or data issues Gather all relevant details needed to understand and scope each issue — client, file type, affected dates, impacted records, and related context Accurately log and categorize incoming issues to support tracking, prioritization, and reporting Impact Analysis: Conduct thorough impact analyses to determine the scope and severity of each issue, including which clients, members, or files are affected Partner with Data Operations team members (ETL Developer/File Management Analyst, Senior Data Operations Engineer, PBM Claims Adjudication Expert) to validate findings and confirm root cause Clearly present impact analysis findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring the level of detail to the listener Status Tracking and Proactive Communication: Build and maintain a dashboard or similar tracking tool that reflects the current status of all open issues Provide proactive, regular updates to client managers, patient care advocates, and other stakeholders — especially when work begins on an issue and when it is resolved Ensure no stakeholder is left wondering about the status of an issue they reported Cross-Functional Liaison: Serve as the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and Client Management on file-related and data issues Serve as the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and Patient Care Advocates on file-related and data issues Build trusted, responsive relationships with both groups to keep communication flowing smoothly in both directions Documentation and Process Improvement: Maintain clear documentation of issues, analyses, and resolutions for future reference and audit needs Identify recurring issues or themes and flag them to the Manager, Data Operations as candidates for a systemic or process fix Continuously refine intake and tracking processes to reduce friction and confusion for everyone involved What you need: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience 2+ years of experience as a business analyst or in a similar liaison/analyst role; healthcare or PBM experience strongly preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate clearly between technical and non-technical audiences Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to break down a reported issue and determine its full scope and impact Experience building and maintaining a dashboard or status-tracking tool (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar) Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple open issues and stakeholders at once A proactive communicator by habit — provides status updates before being asked, not after Comfortable working cross-functionally with both business teams (Client Management, Patient Care Advocates) and technical teams (Data Operations) Familiarity with PBM eligibility, accumulator, or claims data a plus Mission-driven, humble, and supportive; holds high standards while fostering trust with everyone involved Aligns with AffirmedRx values, promoting trust, accountability, and innovation Willingness to travel (10%-20%) What you get: To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business matches.d: Apollo .io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo .io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo .io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. Apollo .io is hiring a Solutions Consultant II to be a trusted technical and strategic advisor across the full customer lifecycle—driving complex, high-stakes deals forward, accelerating time-to-value, and influencing long-term business outcomes. They are not only experts in solution architecture, but also serve as player-coaches who scale the impact of the SC function through mentorship, strategic influence, and reusable assets. You will partner with AEs and AMs, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to architect end-to-end solutions—from discovery through onboarding and expansion. You will also help scale the Solution Consulting team by building reusable assets, documenting best practices, and mentoring peers. Align Apollo to ROI, operational efficiency, and revenue impact through tailored narratives and demos, presenting confidently to technical and non-technical audiences. Sales Partnership – Co-own complex deals with AEs, influencing stakeholders, navigating buying committees, and mitigating evaluation risk through multi-threading. Produce system diagrams, data flows, and architecture that align with buyer objectives. Tooling & Product Strategy – Service as the voice of the customer advising on GTM stack optimization and bring actionable feedback from the field to influence product roadmap priorities, GTM strategy, and customer experience. Full-funnel Solution Management – Co-create solutions that drive adoption, manage process change, and work closely with Onboarding and CS teams to mitigate post-sale risk to value realization. Mentorship & Enablement – Coach peers on discovery, demos, and technical strategy; contribute to internal enablement sessions. Build playbooks, demo environments, templates, and competitive resources that accelerate the entire team. Proven ability to lead technical validation with a consultative approach that reduces evaluation risk and accelerates sales velocity for strategic accounts. Background in integration-heavy customer lifecycles, especially in RevOps and sales tech stack. Understanding of REST APIs, CRMs, data pipelines, and sales/marketing automation tools , with the ability to design scalable, integration-rich solutions. Executive-level communication skills — able to present credibly to VP- and C-level stakeholders while adapting technical depth to the audience. Cross-functional operator — partners effectively with Sales, Onboarding, CS, Product, and Engineering to deliver measurable customer outcomes. Comfortable leveraging AI-native GTM tools in daily workflows to enhance discovery, solution design, and customer enablement. Experience maximizing post-sale GTM tech impact — architecting adoption, enablement, and expansion strategies that help revenue teams realize the full value of their technology investments and drive measurable pipeline or retention gains. Nice to Have Past experience at a fast-growing PLG or dual-motion SaaS company . Proven success as a player-coach — mentoring peers, contributing scalable assets, and elevating team performance. matches.d: Who we are Athos Commerce enables ecommerce and digital marketing teams greater control over how their products are found, merchandised, and sold—on-site and across all digital marketing channels. Our tools span AI-powered search, personalized recommendations, smart merchandising, optimized product data syndication, A/B testing, and marketplace/social commerce performance. We help brands grow with sharper visibility, higher conversion, and less friction. Backed by PSG Equity and supported by a global team across North America, Europe, and APAC, we are building a unified commerce platform that helps retailers deliver better shopping experiences. We win when a merchandiser can do their job in our product faster than anywhere else. Our job is to know that person's problems, motivations, and limitations better than our competitors do, and to build against them. Who You Are You are an analytical, highly organized, and collaborative professional who thrives in building structure out of ambiguity. You enjoy solving complex problems, improving processes, and enabling teams to operate more effectively. You are equally comfortable working with data, developing scalable frameworks, and communicating with stakeholders across different functions and levels of leadership. You are a proactive problem-solver who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You understand how to influence without direct authority, hold well-defined points of view, challenge teams to rethink their operating modelschallenge existing processes constructively, and bring cross-functional teams together around shared goals. You are adaptable, detail-oriented, and motivated by creating systems that help product teams make better decisions and deliver stronger business outcomes. What You'll Do As our Product Operations Lead, reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, you will play a critical role in building and scaling an outcome-oriented product organization. You will own and optimize the processes, analytics, tools, and communication frameworks that enable our Product Managers to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Support, you will improve how we plan, measure, communicate, and execute product initiatives. This is a hands-on opportunity to establish scalable operational foundations, improve product visibility, and drive greater alignment across our global organization. This is a build role. Much of what you will own does not exist yet in a durable form. How You Will Succeed Drive Product Analytics and Insights: Develop and maintain product health, customer adoption, and performance metrics that support data-driven product decisions and align with business objectives. Build Dashboards and Reporting: Analyze product usage data using SQL and business intelligence tools such as Metabase, creating dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to Product teams and executive leadership. Lead Product Planning Processes: Partner with the Chief Product Officer to coordinate quarterly OKRs, product roadmap planning, release schedules, and launch readiness, including planning around retail peak seasons and code freezes. Optimize Product Operations: Establish and continuously improve scalable processes, workflows, and documentation across the Product organization, leveraging tools such as Aha!, Asana, and Guru. Own Product Request Management: Develop and manage a centralized process for incoming product requests, including intake, prioritization, triage, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communication. Strengthen Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact and roadmap subject matter expert for a key liaison between Product and customer-facing teams, ensuring stakeholders have accurate visibility into product priorities, roadmap developments, upcoming releases, and feature changes. Enable Go-to-Market Teams: Partner with Sales Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support to ensure new product capabilities are clearly understood, effectively demonstrated, and accurately communicated to customers and prospects. Champion the Voice of the Customer: Establish consistent processes for collecting, organizing, and synthesizing customer feedback, surveys, interviews, and product insights as a standing input toto inform product planning and prioritization, rather than an occasional exercise. Drive Product Communication: Develop and maintain regular product updates, executive reporting, roadmap reviews, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve transparency and organizational alignment. Build a Scalable Product Function: Identify operational gaps, introduce effective frameworks, and lead cross-functional improvements that increase efficiency, accountability, and the overall maturity of the Product organization. What We're Looking For 4+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, product analytics, or a similar cross-functional role within a technology organization. Experience working in B2B SaaS, ecommerce technology, retail technology, or commerce platforms strongly preferred. Strong proficiency in SQL, including hands-on experience querying databases, analyzing datasets, and translating findings into actionable business insights. Experience building dashboards and reports using business intelligence platforms such as Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Hands-on experience implementing or managing digital product analytics platforms such as Userflow, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics 4 (GA4). Experience supporting product planning cycles, OKR development, roadmap management, and cross-functional execution across distributed teams. Proficiency with product knowledge, project management, and collaboration tools such as Aha!, Asana, Guru, Jira, or Confluence. Strong understanding of product performance metrics, customer adoption, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present insights and recommendations to senior leadership. Demonstrated ability to build scalable processes, manage competing priorities, and influence stakeholders across multiple departments. Strong analytical thinking, organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort working with incomplete or complex datasets. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing strategic initiatives with hands-on execution. Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience. Healthcare background is highly preferred. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving multiple teams. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Ability to influence and coordinate stakeholders without direct authority. Proficiency with common project management, collaboration, and productivity tools. Organization: Creates structure, maintains accurate documentation, and effectively manages competing priorities. Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across Product and partner functions. Communication: Clearly communicates status, risks, decisions, and next steps. Problem Solving: Identifies issues and develops practical solutions. Influence: Gains alignment and drives accountability without formal authority. Adaptability: Effectively navigates changing priorities and ambiguity. Product Orientation: Understands the connection between customer needs, product priorities, technology, and business outcomes. What you will be doing: Program Management Manage the day-to-day execution of assigned product programs and initiatives. Develop and maintain program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies. Coordinate activities across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and other stakeholder teams. Track progress against commitments and proactively identify potential delays or issues. Maintain clear documentation and visibility into program status. Ensure action items, decisions, and follow-ups are clearly documented and completed. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Managers and functional leads to coordinate execution of product initiatives. Facilitate working sessions, planning meetings, status meetings, and project reviews. Build alignment across teams with shared goals and interdependent deliverables. Follow up on commitments and help teams resolve execution issues. Serve as a central point of coordination for assigned programs. Product Development & Launch Support product initiatives across discovery, planning, development, testing, launch, and post-launch activities. Coordinate launch readiness activities across relevant Product and business teams. Track key launch dependencies and ensure outstanding items are identified and addressed. Support development of launch plans, timelines, communications, and readiness checklists. Help coordinate post-launch activities and follow-up actions. Risk & Dependency Management Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints that may affect program delivery. Work with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans and resolve blockers. Escalate significant issues when additional support or decision-making is required. Maintain program-level risk and dependency tracking. Provide timely visibility into changes that may impact scope, schedule, or deliverables. Product Planning & Operations Support quarterly and annual product planning activities. Help maintain visibility into roadmap initiatives, milestones, dependencies, and priorities. Support Product leadership and Product Managers with planning materials, reporting, and operational processes. Develop and maintain dashboards, status reports, and other program-management artifacts. Identify opportunities to improve product planning and execution processes. Contribute to the development and adoption of consistent Product operating practices. Communication & Reporting Provide clear and concise program updates to Product and cross-functional stakeholders. Prepare status reports, presentations, dashboards, and other program communications. Communicate changes to timelines, scope, risks, and dependencies in a timely manner. Ensure stakeholders understand decisions, responsibilities, and next steps. matches.d: Job Title: IT Project Manager (PMP), School-Based Services EHR Implementation Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays) Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule) Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week Pay Rate: $70/hr (W-2) Engagement Type: Contract, currently estimated to end in December 2027 Final Interview: Client interview by phone or video Position Summary Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring an IT Project Manager on behalf of the client, a state government health and human services agency. The agency is implementing a statewide electronic health record (EHR) and Medicaid billing solution for its Medicaid School-Based Services program, equipping school-based practitioners to document services and support Medicaid billing. The Project Manager works within the state's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), follows its hybrid project lifecycle (Agile practices during implementation), and manages the project day to day alongside the state project team and the implementation vendor. Key Responsibilities Create and maintain the project schedule in the EPMO-prescribed tool (activities, dependencies, milestones, resources, percent complete), updated weekly through closeout, and take part in weekly updates to the implementation vendor's master schedule. Deliver weekly project status reports in the state's project management tool. Create and maintain risks and issues, recommend responses, and run monthly risk and issue reviews. Facilitate project meetings, including status, risk/issue review, backlog grooming, release planning and change review; publish agendas 24 hours before and minutes 24 hours after. Track project financials and enter actual expenditures in the EPMO tool monthly or as approved changes affect the budget. Manage change control with the EPMO portfolio manager and state governance committees, using the state's Change Request Form, and track changes in the project tool. Track all deliverables in a deliverable approval matrix and manage the implementation vendor's Deliverable Expectation Documents (DED) and Deliverable Acceptance Forms (DAF). Maintain the stakeholder register, decision log and action item log; engage sponsors and governance committees on policy decisions, scope, resources, budget and escalated issues. Facilitate project activities, including the state's procurement process. Produce deliverables required by state, agency and federal governance (for example CMS), following EPMO templates. Organize and archive project artifacts in the state document repository. Run lessons learned and produce the project closeout report. Requirements Required: Current PMP certification (copy of certificate required with submission). Willing to complete HIPAA training after selection and maintain it for the duration of the engagement (not required to apply). Experience managing IT implementation projects for state government, preferably health and human services or Medicaid programs. Experience managing an implementation vendor's schedule and deliverables, including deliverable review and acceptance. Experience with hybrid or Agile delivery, including backlog grooming and release planning. Proficiency with Azure DevOps and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project, Visio) and Adobe PDF. Strong organization, document repository management, and written and verbal communication. Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time. Located in and authorized to work in the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099). Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems through Azure Virtual Desktop, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings. Preferred: EHR, electronic health record, Medicaid billing, MMIS or school-based health services implementation experience. Experience working within a state Enterprise Project Management Office and its templates and governance. Experience producing deliverables for CMS or other federal partner oversight. How to Apply Please send your resume and a copy of your PMP certificate to with "IT Project Manager, School-Based Services EHR" in the subject line. Originally posted on Himalayas

matches.d: BUILD A SAFER WORLD. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Deployment Strategist team at TRM Labs helps government and law enforcement customers get full value from TRM’s intelligence platforms after the deal closes. As a Deployment Strategist supporting the public sector law enforcement segment, you will be the trusted advisor that state, local, campus, and federal investigators turn to as they trace illicit funds, adopt new workflows, and build cases. This role sits at the intersection of blockchain intelligence expertise and hands-on customer partnership, which is what makes Deployment Strategy at TRM different from a typical customer success seat. The impact you will have: - Act as the trusted advisor for a portfolio of law enforcement customers, helping investigators translate TRM’s platform into faster, stronger cases against money laundering, fraud, and sanctions evasion. - Build and deliver both product onboarding training and broader blockchain and investigative training for customers, extending your expertise as part of TRM’s instructor cadre. - Carry the Voice of the Customer back to Product and Engineering, making sure investigator pain points actually shape the roadmap. What we’re looking for: - 5+ years of experience in public sector work, ideally in law enforcement, financial crime, or a related investigative capacity, with genuine comfort supporting active law enforcement investigations involving money laundering, financial crime, sanctions evasion, and fraud. - Practical, hands-on experience with blockchain analysis and virtual currencies, ideally in an investigative context. - Demonstrated AI fluency: you can point to a specific workflow you built or automated (beyond using ChatGPT to summarize a document) and describe the outcome it drove for your team. - Ability to use AI tools to scale a growing book of business, while still knowing exactly when a customer conversation needs a real, unscripted human response. About the Team: - The Public Sector Deployment Strategist team is distributed, not distant. We work across time zones but stay in close, constant contact through Slack and shared documentation. - You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and TRM Academy, and you’ll be the person law enforcement customers trust to translate their investigative priorities into what TRM builds next. - The team is mission-focused and customer-obsessed. We measure ourselves by whether customers renew, expand, and refer us, not by ticket counts. - Decisions get made quickly and collaboratively, with day-to-day account calls owned by the Deployment Strategist and larger strategic account decisions escalated to team leadership. Team Operating Rhythms: - Weekly customer syncs with your assigned accounts, plus bi-weekly health syncs with the DS team and leadership. - Regular squad calls with your aligned Sales team to stay coordinated on renewal and expansion motions. - Async daily check-ins via Slack, with detailed documentation standing in for meetings whenever possible. - Quarterly business reviews and customer webinars, run on a predictable cadence so customers always know what’s next. Required online and collaboration hours: - Schedule: Core overlap during North America business hours On-Call Responsibilities: - Schedule: About one weekend on call per month after ramp, checking Slack and Intercom roughly every couple of hours for urgent customer issues. There is no pager rotation. - Frequency: Most weekends pass without a page. When something does come up, it’s typically a customer-blocking issue needing a same-day response. Travel Requirements: - Schedule: Occasional travel within the United States and Canada for customer visits, trainings, and conferences. - Frequency: A few trips per quarter, typically short (2 to 3 days). Onsite Requirements: - Schedule: Not applicable, this role is fully remote. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: - Measurable example #1: When a growing group of accounts started overwhelming live onboarding capacity, a Deployment Strategist built an async video walkthrough that now covers roughly 75% of what live onboarding calls used to handle, cutting new-agency ramp time from weeks to days. - Measurable example #2: When a customer’s usage data flagged early signs of churn risk, a Deployment Strategist raised it the same day in the internal escalation channel, looped in the account team, and had a save plan in motion before the next business day. - Measurable example #3: During a company-wide offsite, Deployment Strategists staffed rotating coverage slots across every time zone so urgent customer issues still got a response inside the one-hour SLA, with no customer left waiting. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. INTERVIEWING WITH TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI FLUENCY AT TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: - Accelerate repeatable workflows - Structure and solve problems - Improve output quality - Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. LIFE AT TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: - Priorities and targets to change quickly - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity - A high level of personal ownership and accountability - Close collaboration across teams and functions - Frequent, high-touch communication - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. Cyera ’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story. THE OPPORTUNITY Cyera is seeking a Program Manager, Identity Security - Customer Success to design, own, and optimize scalable programs that help our customers adopt and get lasting value from Cyera ’s identity security solutions. This role is a key interface between the Customer Success team, Product, and Sales Engineering, and will balance program management, content creation, and execution. As identity becomes the control point for how people, machines, and AI agents access enterprise data, Customer Success teams need deep fluency in identity security and a repeatable way to bring customers to value. You’ll partner with Customer Success leadership, Product, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to bring clarity, consistency, and creativity to onboarding, adoption, and readiness efforts. matches.d: Thrive delivers upon the promise of technology by enabling our clients’ digital transformation journeys with best practices on an AI, cybersecurity and cloud focused NextGen managed services platform. Thrive ’s culture is powered by diverse talent, big ideas, and a customer-first mindset—and it’s what truly sets us apart. Thrive is built for people who want more than a weekday routine. If you’re hungry to grow, eager to tackle new challenges and ready to drive real impact in a rapidly expanding environment, then welcome to THRIVE! About The Role We are building AI into the way our go-to-market organization operates, sells, serves customers, and scales. This role exists to identify the highest-value opportunities for AI across the revenue engine, prove the business case with data, and build practical agents and workflows that improve productivity, decision quality, speed, and customer experience. This is a hands-on, business-facing builder role for someone who can operate across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. You will not simply receive a backlog. You will create one by finding friction, quantifying the opportunity, designing the solution, building and testing it, launching it with the field, and measuring whether it worked. The right person blends GTM judgment, AI fluency, data analysis, and enough technical depth to move from idea to production. This is not an advisory-only role and it is not a research role. It is for someone who can ship useful AI-enabled workflows that real teams adopt. Why This Role Matters Now AI is moving from experimentation to operating model. For GTM teams, that means the biggest advantage will not come from isolated tools or demos. It will come from thoughtful, governed workflows that help sellers prepare faster, managers coach with better insight, marketers target with more precision, and customer-facing teams act sooner on risk and opportunity. This role will help define how we responsibly apply AI across the revenue organization, improving scale without simply adding more manual effort or headcount. Example Use Cases Sales meeting prep agents that summarize account context, recent activity, open opportunities, risks, and recommended next actions. Account research workflows that combine internal data and approved external inputs to support prospecting and account planning. Renewal and churn risk agents that summarize signals, surface next-best actions, and support executive review processes. CRM hygiene and data quality automation, including enrichment, duplicate detection, field validation, and follow-up prompts. Post-call and post-meeting workflows that draft follow-ups, update CRM fields, identify action items, and flag coaching opportunities. Manager insight workflows that summarize pipeline movement, forecast changes, seller activity patterns, and execution risks. Marketing and sales alignment workflows that help connect campaign engagement to account prioritization and rep action. What You'll Do Find the opportunities Work across marketing, SDR/BDR, sales, customer success, and revenue operations to map how work actually gets done today: the manual steps, the handoffs, the queues, and the places where reps and managers lose time. Maintain a living, prioritized inventory of AI and automation opportunities across the GTM funnel, scored on impact, effort, risk, and data readiness. Pressure-test demand: separate problems that need AI from problems that need a process fix, a field on a record, or a better report. Bring recommendations forward with a clear thesis: what the problem costs today, what the intervention is, what it will cost, and what changes if we do it. Understand what drives the need Pull and analyze the data behind each opportunity: CRM, marketing automation, engagement and sequencing tools, support and CS platforms, product usage, and finance where relevant. Quantify the baseline before anything is built: volume, cycle time, conversion, cost per unit of work, error and rework rates. Define the success metric and the measurement method up front, and instrument the workflow so results are observable rather than anecdotal. Report on adoption and realized impact after launch, and be candid when something is not working. Build agents and workflows Design and build AI agents and automated workflows across multiple platforms: CRM-native automation, workflow and integration tools, agent-building platforms, and LLM APIs. Own the full build cycle: prototype, test against real data, pilot with a small user group, harden, launch, and iterate. Write and refine prompts, retrieval logic, tool definitions, and guardrails so agents behave reliably in production, not just in a demo. Handle the plumbing: data flows, integrations, field mapping, deduplication, error handling, and fallbacks to a human when an agent is out of its depth. Document what you build so it is supportable by someone other than you. Drive adoption Partner with GTM leaders and frontline teams so what you build gets used: training, enablement materials, office hours, and a feedback loop into the next iteration. Treat adoption as part of the deliverable. Workflows must be designed, launched, and measured in a way that makes them useful in the field, not just impressive in a demo. Keep it safe and governed Apply sensible guardrails around data handling, customer-facing output, and human review, particularly anything that touches prospects or customers directly.
