matches.d: Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Hardware Integration Project Manager (Facilities & Equipment) to join our team. This role sits at the intersection of product development, engineering, and real-world deployment. You will lead the implementation of emerging technologies from early-stage prototypes through to scalable, deployable design standards. Your job is to make sure new products actually work in real environments — not just in theory — and to identify and solve integration challenges before they become costly issues. This is not a traditional construction project management role. You will be working upstream in the development cycle, helping shape how products are designed, tested, and implemented across physical spaces. You will work closely with architecture and engineering teams, vendors, and consultants to validate and implement solutions. The environment is evolving. Many processes are still being built. You will need to be comfortable operating with incomplete information and helping to define the path forward. Responsibilities: Own the implementation path for new products from prototype through standardization Work directly with engineering, product, facilities, security, and operations teams to validate real-world requirements early Translate prototypes and concepts into deployable solutions that can be installed, maintained, and scaled Identify integration risks across physical environments (space constraints, power, network, installation methods, storage, etc.) and drive mitigation plans Coordinate with external vendors, manufacturers, and consultants to ensure solutions are viable and executable Build and manage the R&D implementation roadmap, ensuring infrastructure and readiness align with product development Communicate status, risks, and key decisions across stakeholders through written updates, working sessions, and reviews Respond quickly to incoming R&D issues (e.g., design gaps, prototype failures, installation blockers) and drive resolution across teams Independently review drawing sets, submittals, and specifications to identify gaps, risks, and implementation issues Strategic thinking – provide guidance to project teams on approaches to achieve client and business objectives Knowledge management – ensure that key information and learnings generated from each project is captured Process improvement – identify ways to improve internal systems and processes as they relate to R&D and your team objectives Lead product vetting against design standards, permitting, and code requirements Define and document repeatable standards based on validated solutions Drive final documentation approval with team leads, ensuring standards, specifications, and design outputs are validated prior to release Facilitate working sessions to align cross-functional teams where requirements are unclear or conflicting Document learnings and help shape emerging design standards and processes SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. Preferred Experience: Mechanical engineering background (strongly preferred) Experience with R&D environments, labs, or prototyping workflows – vetting and validating products against the client standards, codes, etc. Background in industrial design or product design validation Experience with vendor and external partner management Familiarity with permitting, codes, and compliance considerations Experience working in ambiguous or early-stage programs Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, Miro, and Asana Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, architecture, or equivalent experience with physical system design/implementation 5–8+ years of experience in roles such as: Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering Architecture (with strong technical/build focus & engineering collaboration) Product implementation / hardware deployment Industrial or systems design tied to physical environments Experience working with physical products, systems, or infrastructure (not just software or digital products implementation) Ability to evaluate how products interact with real-world constraints (space, power, installation, environment, maintenance, and access) Proven ability to take concepts or early-stage designs and make them executable in real-world environments Strong organizational and management skills – collaborating across multiple disciplines (engineering, operations, vendors, facilities, etc.) Strong requirements gathering and problem-solving skills Excellent collaboration and communication skills Experience reviewing and providing QA/QC of design drawings, technical documents, and/or product specifications Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu and Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace products The salary range for this full-time role is $140K-$160K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community. Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive end-to-end alignment across Carrier Relations, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and GTM teams to achieve core company goals. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. Offerings vary by location. Over 17,000 Organizations Worldwide Rely On SHI’s Concierge Approach To Help Them Solve What’s Next. But The Heartbeat Of SHI Is Our Employees – All 7,000 Of Them. If You Join Our Team, You’ll Enjoy • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S. • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities. • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family. • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. Job Summary The Presales Solutions Engineer – OT/IoT Security will be a customer-facing security expert. They will take a consultative approach to security projects and have a holistic understanding of how security technology enables business. The Solutions Engineer will also develop and deliver new security services offerings to address customer requests/opportunities. This is a remote position required to reside in the Northeast region of the US as required for business needs and as determined by SHI management. Role Description • Collaboration with multiple layers of contacts within client organizations, including but not limited to CIO, CSO, CISO, Security Engineers, and procurement to strengthen our overall customer relationship and better understand the goals and objectives they are trying to achieve. • Understand the company’s services offerings in all solution practice areas by attending company training and expanding knowledge through self-study. • Educate sales teams on cybersecurity solution selling and key technologies through 1x1, team, and company training. • Staying current on new technology, trends, and market behavior by studying market trends and the industry landscape. • Engaging in self-study and independent work in lab facilities to increase job-related knowledge and skills. • Developing collateral to assist with cybersecurity sales engagements. • Developing use cases in the SHI lab to support sales engagements. Behaviors and Competencies • Presenting: Can design and deliver engaging presentations, adapting the content and style to suit the audience, context, and medium. • Negotiation: Can proactively seek out negotiation opportunities, initiate discussions, and contribute to conflict resolution. • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others. • Detail-Oriented: Can manage complex tasks or projects, identifying errors or inconsistencies, and ensuring all details are addressed, necessary corrections are made, and quality is maintained. • Organization: Can effectively coordinate multiple projects, delegate tasks where appropriate, and employ advanced organizational tools and methods. • Follow-Up: Can proactively identify tasks that require follow-up, initiate necessary actions, and contribute to efficient workflow management. • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions. • Relationship Building: Can proactively seek out opportunities to expand networks, initiate collaborations, and contribute to team cohesion. • Documentation: Can develop comprehensive documentation standards, implement best practices, and ensure documentation supports operational efficiency. • Results Orientation: Can set challenging goals for their team and lead them to achieve these goals, demonstrating a consistent track record of results. Skill Level Requirements • Deep security knowledge in the OT/IoT space (protocol awareness, traffic analysis, asset visibility, segmentation strategies) • Familiarity with OT/IoT industrial protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, and SCADA • Excellent presentation skills, including the ability to run demos on cloud security products • Outstanding written and verbal communication • Attention to detail, organization, and follow-up skills • Initiative to research and resolve problems with a positive attitude • Exceptional relationship-building acumen • Strong documentation skills to include system/network diagrams and presentations • General understanding of security frameworks such as NIST, HITRUST, CIS, Etc. • Possess a real passion for technology • Expert technical knowledge of security solutions Other Requirements • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required • 5+ years experience in a Technical Cybersecurity role • 3+ years experience in Security Pre-Sales Consulting • Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events Preferred Certifications • CISSP, Relevant GIAC Cert, SSCP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, CPT, CWSP, CCNP Security, CCIE Security or Relevant Professional certifications in Cyber Security OEMs If you do not have these certifications, it may be required within one year at SHI. The base salary range for this position is $96,000 - $184,000. The estimated on-target earnings, or OTE, which includes a base salary and bonus, are $120,000 - $230,000. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

matches.d: The Solutions Engineer is a customer-facing technical partner who works closely with Sales to help prospective customers understand, evaluate, and successfully validate Bolster’s platform. This role combines technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a consultative approach to uncover customer needs, demonstrate relevant capabilities, and guide customers through technical evaluations. The Solutions Engineer supports the sales cycle from technical discovery through solution validation, including product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, integrations, and technical due diligence. This role also serves as an important connection between customers and Bolster’s Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams by sharing feedback and helping ensure a smooth transition from evaluation to adoption. Location: Remote (U.S. only) Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas or provide employment-based immigration support for this position now or in the future. Key Responsibilities: Partner with Account Executives as the primary technical resource throughout the sales process, from discovery through technical validation and close. Conduct technical discovery to understand customer environments, security challenges, workflows, integration requirements, and success criteria. Translate customer requirements into solutions using Bolster’s platform and capabilities. Deliver engaging product demonstrations, technical presentations, and workshops tailored to customer use cases and priorities. Plan and execute proof-of-value engagements, including defining scope and success criteria, configuring the solution, troubleshooting technical issues, and presenting results. Help customers understand deployment requirements, APIs, integrations, data flows, authentication, and other technical considerations. Address technical questions and objections throughout the evaluation process and clearly communicate Bolster’s capabilities and differentiators. Partner with Customer Success to support a smooth handoff from pre-sales evaluation to implementation and adoption. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to communicate customer feedback, product requirements, and technical challenges identified during sales engagements. Develop and maintain reusable technical resources, including demo environments, integration examples, technical documentation, and enablement materials. Stay current on cybersecurity trends, competitive solutions, and evolving customer requirements related to digital risk and online fraud. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management Required Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Security Engineering, or a related customer-facing technical role. Experience supporting SaaS, cybersecurity, or other technical solutions in enterprise customer environments. Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and technologies, preferably including digital risk protection, phishing, brand impersonation, threat intelligence, external attack surface management, or related disciplines. Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn products, APIs, integrations, and customer environments. Experience delivering product demonstrations and conducting technical evaluations or proof-of-value engagements. Ability to translate technical capabilities into customer outcomes and business value. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work collaboratively with internal teams to identify solutions. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer evaluations and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Collaborative approach and experience working with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams. Why Join Bolster? Bolster is redefining fraud and brand protection. Our AI-driven SaaS platform detects and takes down phishing and scam sites in real time, protecting the world’s top brands and millions of consumers. Our culture values collaboration, curiosity, and ownership — every team member has a voice and an impact. We believe in building elegant, scalable solutions while maintaining a spirit of experimentation and fun. Learn more about our cultural values: bolster.ai/about-us What we offer: -Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance -Flexible time off + paid holidays. -Equity + 401(k) plan Equal Opportunity Employer Bolster is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

matches.d: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. Our Applications Engineers are highly technical, customer-facing problem solvers who play a critical role in deploying Shield AI’s Hivemind software in real-world environments. This role is travel-intensive, with frequent trips, often international, and sometimes lasting multiple weeks, to work directly alongside customers on-site. This is primarily a Senior-level role, and we’re typically looking for candidates with several years of relevant industry experience. That said, we will consider exceptional mid-level engineers who demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, a hands-on mindset, and a track record of taking initiative in dynamic, customer-driven environments In this role, you will work closely with customers to understand their requirements, provide technical expertise during deployment, and ensure successful integration of our AI and autonomy products. You’ll also collaborate internally with engineering teams, with opportunities to grow into technical leadership over time. You Should Apply If: You’re excited about a travel-heavy role and enjoy being on-site with customers, including international and multi-week engagements You’re a strong technical contributor (or early in your career and eager to grow) who takes initiative and figures things out You enjoy problem solving, building relationships, and working at the intersection of engineering and real-world deployment You’re passionate about autonomy, robotics, or aerospace You Should Not Apply If: You prefer minimal travel or want to work primarily from a single location You want to do 100% R&D and don’t enjoy customer interactions You’ve never programmed in C, C++, or Rust What you'll do: : Deploy with customers on site globally (~50% travel) to support software integration and development activities. Become an expert user of the Hivemind enterprise software stack and its various autonomy modules. Provide technical support and training to customers. Develop AI & Autonomy applications using the Shield AI enterprise software development kit Assist the sales team in pre-sales activities, e.g., demos, conferences, immersions Assist in post-sales deployment and integration of Shield AI enterprise software products. Develop and maintain technical documentation and training materials. Help customers debug software/API integration issues. Collaborate with the product engineering team to address customer feedback and improve products. Required qualifications:: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 5+ years of experience of industry experience 2+ years of experience in an integration/applications engineering role 2+ years of experience working in a startup environment. Strong technical background in software engineering. Strong proficiency in writing modern C++ code. Intermediate proficiency in writing Python code. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred qualifications:: Experience in the defense aviation or robotics industry. Experience building and running a small enterprise software applications/solutions engineering team. Advanced technical degree, especially in robotics or autonomy related fields Senior Engineer: $152000-$228,000 Staff Engineer: $181,000-$272,000 Senior Staff Engineer: $212,000-$318,000 Full-time regular employee offer package: Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity Temporary employee offer package: Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment) Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information. ### Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

matches.d: About Leena AI Leena AI is an agentic AI platform that ships pre-built, pre-trained AI Colleagues for HR, IT, and Finance and gives enterprises a low-code/no-code agent studio to automate their back office. A Gartner Leader three years running, we power 20M+ employees across 500+ global enterprises—including Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Panasonic, and MongoDB—auto-resolving 70%+ of tickets and delivering 4–10× measured ROI, with customers live in 45 days. About the Role Sales Engineers at Leena AI lead technical pre-sales engagements with Fortune 1000 / Global 2000 enterprises. As a key member of the field sales team, you'll wear many hats—from executive-level platform demos to deeply technical solution architecture, integrations, and proofs of value. Acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, you'll translate agentic AI capabilities—AI Colleagues, low-code/no-code workflow automation, API and MCP/A2A interoperability, and enterprise-grade governance—into measurable business outcomes that win deals and drive customer success. Responsibilities Own the technical side of the entire sales cycle: highly engaging custom product demonstrations and presentations, solution architecture, RFI/RFP responses, security questionnaires, integrations, and the POC/POV process. Design and build compelling proofs of value—configuring AI Colleagues, agentic workflows, and Agent Operating Protocols (AOPs) using Leena AI's low-code/no-code studio to map directly to each customer's use cases. Partner with in-region Account Executives to plan for, target, and expand new and existing enterprise accounts. Architect integrations across the customer's HR, IT, and Finance stack (e.g., Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle) using REST APIs, pre-built connectors, and MCP/A2A interoperability. Serve as an internal and external Subject Matter Expert on Leena AI's platform, integrations, and agentic AI use cases. Collaborate with the global SE team, engineering, and product management to share customer feedback, design guidance, and best practices. Provide channel partner technical enablement and support, and represent Leena AI at regional trade shows and events, as assigned. Requirements Requirements 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role—sales/solutions engineering, services consulting, or customer success—supporting enterprise customers. Superb customer-facing skills, including executive presentations, live demos, and clear written communication. Strong technical contributor across modern technologies, with experience architecting complex SaaS solutions and API integrations. Hands-on familiarity with AI and agentic AI technologies—LLMs, RAG, prompt design, AI agents, and orchestration. Experience building or configuring low-code/no-code workflow automations. Experience with value- or solution-selling approaches, and comfortable operating in a consultative selling environment. Substantial expertise with at least two of the following: Agentic AI & Automation – AI Colleagues/agents, orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, low-code/no-code workflow builders. APIs & Interoperability – RESTful APIs, webhooks, and emerging agent standards such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent). Enterprise SaaS Integrations – HR, IT, and Finance systems such as Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and Oracle. Cloud/SaaS – Scalability, cloud providers, security assessments, and encryption. Infrastructure & Security – Networking, firewalls, VPNs, AD, SAML, SSO, and AI governance/observability.

matches.why: Target customer-facing technical title at an early-stage AI security startup, focusing on demos, discovery, and customer trust.
matches.d: ABOUT CLEARLY AI Most security teams review what they can, triaging a backlog by urgency and headcount while products ship without review. Clearly AI is the continuous threat modeling platform that gives security, privacy, and GRC teams the capacity to cover more, with accurate, source-cited assessments that enterprise teams trust. We're live with Fortune 500s and global brands including Rivian, Ericsson, HID Global, PayPal, and others. We've reviewed thousands of security-critical products, from badge scanners to stablecoin platforms to autonomous driving features. Backed by Y Combinator, Basis Set Ventures, Crosspoint Capital, Argon Ventures, and Ritual Capital. Selected as a Top 10 Finalist for the RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox Contest. Advised by former CISOs of Disney, Costco, Amplitude, Chevron, the former CEO of Reddit, and the former CPO of Brex. We are early. We are deeply technical. We are building alongside real practitioners, and we want a real practitioner who can stand in front of our buyers and be believed. LOCATION Seattle/SF preferred, remote OK. We meet in person 1-2x per quarter. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS Our buyers are security, AppSec, GRC, and privacy leaders at Fortune 500s who will stress-test the product and then stress-test us. They need someone who can: - Understand how their reviews actually run across threat modeling, privacy, and vendor risk - Demo Clearly AI against their own artifacts and processes, not a generic sandbox - Design and run proofs of value against written success criteria - Answer architecture and data-handling questions live, in front of people who will check the answer This role exists to own the technical case, paired with Sales, who runs the deal. WHAT YOU'LL OWN 1. Technical discovery and demos - Go deep on how a prospect runs reviews today, and spot which part will break before they do - Push on the stated request to find the real goal. Often the right answer is smaller than what they asked for - Build demos on their own use case and artifacts, not a generic sandbox 2. Proof of value - Turn vague asks like "less effort" or "reasonable quality" into criteria a POV can pass or fail - Stand up tenants, load their knowledge, queue historical and live cases - Run the midpoint check and the technical readout against what the customer signed 3. The technical conversation - Own the architecture questions that decide enterprise deals: tenancy and data isolation, SSO/SAML/SCIM, deployment patterns, model providers, data residency, audit defensibility - Answer accuracy and hallucination objections with evidence, and carry our security posture through their vendor review - Explain honestly where we fit against threat modeling tools, scanners, GRC platforms, and building it in-house 4. The reusable layer - Turn evaluation friction into specific, reproducible feedback for engineering - Build the demo environments, POV templates, and technical answers the team can use without you WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT - Not our Forward Deployed Security Engineer role; you hand off at signature rather than running production onboarding - Not a product management role - Not a role where you read someone else's demo script WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required - 5+ years either running security and privacy reviews for large enterprises, or in a sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical pre-sales role selling to security teams - Command of enterprise security architecture: tenancy and data isolation, data residency, AI governance - Ability to speak the language of security practitioners (STRIDE, DPIA, TPRM, CVE, SSDLC) - Experience running a multi-week technical engagement to a deadline without it drifting - Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, Confluence, or OneTrust, and how review workflows live inside them - Clear writing. Success criteria, test plans, and readouts are the deliverables here Strongly preferred - Hands-on experience with threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, or vendor risk assessments - Working knowledge of enterprise identity and deployment plumbing: SSO/SAML/SCIM, IP allowlisting, model providers - Experience working in early-stage startups You do not need to have carried a quota or held a sales title. If this role fits you and you don't check every box, tell us what you'd bring instead. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED (FIRST 12 MONTHS) - POVs passing against criteria you wrote - Technical objections resolved in the room rather than escalated - Time to run a full technical evaluation without a founder present - Demo environments, templates, and answers the team uses every week WHY JOIN CLEARLY AI - Build the technical function from the ground up, with the team that follows built around what you establish - See your impact directly in the product, and in the customers we win - Join an RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox Top 10 Finalist backed by $8.4M in seed funding - YC alum with proven, technical founders and strong growth momentum with minimal funding taken to date - Competitive salary, equity, and benefits Salary ranges are a guideline; actual base salary may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified. In addition, compensation packages may include additional components such as equity and benefits. Benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations.

matches.why: Forward deployed discovery and implementation role aligns well, though it asks for 6+ years of experience and substantial travel.
matches.d: FORWARD DEPLOYED PRODUCT MANAGER Location: U.S. (Remote, but must be based in the United States) Travel: Depending on the assigned engagement, substantial travel to state government partner sites may be expected Clearance: Must be eligible and able to pass a government background check ABOUT SPRUCE Spruce builds privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing solutions that give individuals control of their information while enabling governments and enterprises to deliver secure, interoperable services. We partner with private and public-sector organizations to modernize how identity is issued, verified, and used. THE ROLE We are seeking a Forward Deployed Product Manager to sit alongside our government customers during discovery, architecture, and design - sometimes while engineering is building - and help them work out what they actually need, and why. You will support specific deployments, beginning with a statewide education and workforce credential initiative. Much of this work is customer-driven today and requires hands-on engagement with individual implementations, even as we work toward consolidating these efforts into reusable Spruce products. Holding both of those at once is the job. Beyond product discovery, you also own ecosystem adoption - getting issuers to issue, verifiers to verify, and learners to adopt - with startup-style resourcefulness and measurable KPIs. The surface area is broad. One week you may be shaping the roadmap for a statewide digital identity wallet, the next a citizen-facing portal, the next the APIs and microservices underneath. You are responsible for the end-to-end product picture and for understanding how those pieces fit together. This is not a roadmap-and-quarterly-planning role. We move quickly, put work in front of small pilot groups, and let evidence change the plan. At the same time, this is identity infrastructure, where security, accessibility, and reliability genuinely matter. Knowing what can be iterated on quickly and what absolutely cannot is central to doing this job well. In some cases, you may source and build that pilot group yourself. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. CUSTOMER-EMBEDDED DISCOVERY - Work directly with state government partners through discovery, architecture, and design - Understand their users, policy environment, constraints, and workflows first-hand - Look past stated requirements to the underlying problem the customer is actually trying to solve - Act as a trusted product advisor to public sector stakeholders 2. END-TO-END PRODUCT OWNERSHIP - Hold the full product picture across a statewide wallet, citizen-facing portals, and the APIs and services beneath them - Help partners shape their roadmap and priorities, and make sure what gets built solves the real problem - Partner closely with engineering, design, and delivery leads from definition through deployment 3. HANDS-ON USER RESEARCH - Personally design and run research: talk to users, stakeholders, and end users directly, conduct discovery, prototype where appropriate - Synthesize what you learn and translate it into product decisions and roadmap direction - Bring user evidence into conversations where requirements are often treated as fixed There is no research team sitting behind this role. You do this work yourself. 4. INFLUENCE IN A PUBLIC SECTOR CONTEXT - Navigate government relationships thoughtfully while introducing evidence that may challenge stated priorities - Influence direction without damaging the relationship - Communicate clearly across users, policy, technical constraints, and business priorities 5. PATTERN RECOGNITION AND PRODUCT STRATEGY - Identify patterns across customers and ask what individual deployments teach us about broader product opportunities - Connect customer needs to reusable product capabilities - Recognize where a problem extends beyond a single agency, and shape product strategy from evidence rather than incoming requests 6. JUDGMENT ABOUT PACE VERSUS RISK - Put work in front of small pilot groups early and let findings redirect the roadmap - Draw clear lines around what cannot be iterated on loosely: security, accessibility, and reliability - Make and defend those calls with engineering and with customers 7. ECOSYSTEM BUILDING & ADOPTION - Drive adoption of digital credentials across the ecosystem - onboard issuers, verifiers, and institutional partners with startup GTM resourcefulness - Find high-leverage partnerships (university research programs, workforce boards, employer networks) that multiply impact beyond your own direct effort - Own adoption KPIs and find creative, resourceful ways to move them - Act as a credible product advisor to executive stakeholders including agency directors, university leadership, and ecosystem partners WHAT YOU BRING - 6–10+ years of product experience at startups or building new product initiatives - Time in an early-stage environment where you personally shipped product and moved quickly - Zero-to-one experience: you have taken a product from nothing to shipped, or identified and pursued entirely new opportunities - Ideally, meaningful experience in education, workforce development, or adjacent sectors - Experience in government or another highly regulated environment - Genuine customer-embedded experience - forward-deployed product, solutions PM, implementation, or founder-led delivery all count - Demonstrated, hands-on user research: you have designed and run discovery yourself and turned it into product decisions - Enough technical depth to sit comfortably with engineers and hold your own on APIs, services, and system design. You do not need to be an engineer - Comfort with ambiguity, a broad surface area, and shifting priorities - Credible at the executive level - comfortable holding a room with agency directors, university chancellors, and institutional partners - Based in the U.S. and excited to engage directly with state government partners - Passion for workforce development and expanding opportunity through technology NICE TO HAVE - Background in digital identity, IAM / ICAM, credentialing, or authentication systems - Familiarity with accessibility standards, FedRAMP, or NIST frameworks - Experience navigating public sector procurement and contracting environments - Prior engineering or deeply technical systems experience - Experience building or growing multi-sided ecosystems, marketplaces, or platform adoption - Background in education technology, learning and employment records, or workforce development programs WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS - Shape identity systems that millions of residents will actually use - Work directly with senior government stakeholders on mission-critical infrastructure - Operate at the intersection of policy, engineering, research, and real-world delivery - Help turn individual state deployments into durable product capability - Help build the education and workforce credential ecosystem that connects citizens to opportunity - Join a small, high-trust team where autonomy and judgment matter At SpruceID, we value diversity of perspectives and backgrounds. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

matches.why: Strong match for an implementation role bridging customers and engineering at an AI-powered health tech startup.
matches.d: OUR VISION Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork. Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay. We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own custo OUR VALUES We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them! - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us. - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do. - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft. - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one. ABOUT VITALIZE’S DEPLOYMENT TEAM Our team is the engine behind Vitalize's growth as we scale our deployment motion from 30 to 300+ hospitals. We own the most complex, highest-stakes enterprise rollouts, and our work directly shapes how new product lines and expansions land with customers. These are the moments that unlock multi-million-dollar ARR, long-term customer success, measurable ROI, and most importantly, real impact for the clinicians and staff using Vitalize every day. THE ROLE You’ll embed directly with nursing executives, hospital operations leaders, finance, and IT to understand how their organizations actually function—not just how they think they function. You’ll diagnose operational bottlenecks, align cross-functional stakeholders, drive organizational change, and architect deployments that fundamentally reshape how health systems staff and operate. For our customers, you aren’t just implementing software—you are the face of Vitalize and a trusted advisor helping them transform one of the most operationally complex environments in healthcare. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own complex, multi-month deployments end to end, managing timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risks across several health systems at once so every go-live lands on time and delivers results - Become a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, nursing leaders, and operational stakeholders as they redesign how labor is planned, staffed, and managed across their health systems - Align executives and cross-functional stakeholders across nursing, operations, IT, finance, HR, PMO, labor relations, and legal, keeping everyone clear on decisions, owners, and next steps through enterprise-wide go-lives - Design and continuously refine repeatable deployment playbooks for academic medical centers and complex, multi-union health systems - Develop a predictable launch motion for new system integrations, including greenfield HRIS and payroll builds - Partner directly with GTM and Customer Success on the internal flows, tools, and processes that drive long-term client success - Work with Product, Design, and Engineering to build and iterate on new product lines, driving ARR growth through expansion WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Clear communication: You communicate with clarity and confidence across every audience, from frontline clinicians to C-suite executives. You simplify complex ideas, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment proactively - Deployment and project management expertise: You’ve managed complex, cross-functional deployments from planning through go-live. You anticipate risks, prioritize well, and bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving environments - Credibility with clinical teams: You partner with nurses, physicians, and hospital staff as a consultant, not just a project manager. You listen first, learn their workflows, and earn trust by solving problems alongside the people doing the work every day - Change management experience: You know successful deployments depend on people, not just technology. You spot resistance early, build buy-in across stakeholder groups, and help organizations adopt new ways of working - A strong sense of ownership: You take initiative without waiting for direction, thrive when things change quickly, and always look for ways to improve processes and move work forward BENEFITS - Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 401(k) with company match - Flexible PTO - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites - Twice-yearly company off-sites - Free meals in the office - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees - Desk setup reimbursement - Commuter benefits - Monthly gym/wellness stipend - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

matches.why: Unusually strong role fit embedding with teams to automate processes with AI agents, directly mirroring your AI workflow automation work.
matches.d: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes. Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization. What you'll do As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool. matches.d: Associate Solutions Consultant Position Summary: We are seeking an Associate Solutions Consultant to drive the ideation, intake, and delivery of use cases once an enterprise agreement has been signed. This role sits within Solutions Consulting and picks up where a deal's signature leaves off: structuring new use cases as a client's book of work grows, running the intake process that turns scattered client requirements into a connected customer experience. The ideal candidate finds energy in sustained account partnership rather than deal-by-deal pursuit, and wants to go deep on the full lifespan of an enterprise relationship instead of discovery-to-proposal in isolation. This role supports active enterprise accounts across the Solutions Consulting team. It does not report to, or sit under, an individual Solutions Consultant. Who You Are: You're driven and organized at your core; someone who keeps a dozen moving pieces straight without being asked twice, and who pushes work to its next step rather than waiting to be told. You're energized by what happens after a deal closes: turning a signed agreement into a living roadmap of use cases that builds, one connected moment at a time, toward a fuller customer experience. Working with a client often over a year or more. You're comfortable with the technical details that come with it: data flows, triggers, what the platform can and can't do today, but you don't treat the existing toolkit as a ceiling. You get real satisfaction from looking at what Drips already has and finding a creative way to combine it to solve a client's next use case, rather than assuming every ask means new product requirement. You can hold several in-flight use cases under one agreement at once, each on its own clock, without losing sight of what's scoped and what's waiting on the client. And above all, you partner naturally with the Solutions Consultant, Implementation, Client Success, and Product who build and run what you ideate. This role only creates value in the handoff, so earning trust across teams has to be instinct, not an afterthought. Key Responsibilities: Drive Post-Signature Use Case Ideation: Partner with client business owners to identify, structure, and sequence new use cases under an existing enterprise agreement, determining what's new build versus reusable functionality, and connecting each one into the client's broader experience rather than treating it as a standalone addition. Own Client Use Case Intake: Maintain intake templates and project spec guides for client business owners. Sequence Discovery Against Governance Timelines: Work backward from the client's go-live date and internal governance cycles to schedule discovery sessions per client business owner as intake forms return, coordinating with a client-side PMO or strategic projects function where one exists. Support Delivery Handoff: Help transfer scope, rationale, and design intent to Implementation, Production, UX, and Client Success at kickoff, and stay a point of continuity for design-intent questions during build. Carry Post-Sales Follow-Through: Submit and track product and feature requests tied to a signed agreement, report request timelines back to the client, and chase Product/Engineering when a request is closed, absorbed, or deprioritized. Maintain Use Case Records: Keep UCA inventory attachment, use case status, and related Salesforce records accurate and current across every active use case under an enterprise agreement. Partner Without Owning the Deal: Work closely with the Solutions Consultant(s) and Director assigned to an enterprise account, escalating business-case, pricing, or scope decisions. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree and/or 1 to 3 years of experience in solutions consulting, implementation, client success, cross-functional project coordination, or a related client-facing or technical-delivery role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Experience with or exposure to healthcare, insurance, education, or another highly regulated industry a plus; demonstrated ability to ramp quickly in a regulated market considered equally. Strong organizational discipline — demonstrated ability to track multiple concurrent workstreams against different timelines without losing detail. Comfort building and refining structured intake templates or processes, and iterating them based on what does and doesn't work with real stakeholders. Working familiarity with use-case or requirements documentation (e.g., PSGs, BRDs) a plus; willingness to learn Drips ' documentation standards required. Familiarity and comfort with discussing data integration concepts and effectively translating and communicating technical requirements to both IT and business stakeholders. (APIs, flat-file/SFTP exchange). Strong Salesforce discipline and comfort maintaining accurate use case and case records. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including comfort coordinating directly with client business owners and internal stakeholders across functions. Comfort operating without formal authority, and the judgment to know when to escalate rather than resolve. Applicant Instructions: All applicants are asked to submit a cover letter alongside their resume that contains the following details: Include two or more of the Key Responsibilities listed above that you have direct experience with and feel confident discussing. Mention the Drips core value (available on our website) you embody the most. Include your salary requirements or range. Keep the cover letter under 250 words. Originally posted on Himalayas

Collaborate with Genesys product and engineering teams by bringing forward customer requirements, evidence-based insights, architectural considerations, and opportunities for innovation. Develop reusable architectures, demonstrations, frameworks, and best practices that improve execution across the Strategic Accounts organization. Create high-quality technical and strategic documentation, including solution architectures, proposals, use cases, pilot plans, and technical recommendations. Contribute thought leadership through customer engagements, presentations, internal enablement, and industry discussions. Hands-on experience applying prompt engineering techniques to real-world use cases. matches.why: Target Technical Account Manager role at a workflow automation tech company, partnering with healthcare clients on post-sale technical adoption.
matches.d: About Vasion For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration. So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal. About the role Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised. At a Glance Segment: Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks Vertical focus: Healthcare Engagement model: Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion Work model: Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm] Success metrics: Gross retention on assigned accounts, risk identified before the customer raises it, adoption milestones met, expansion ARR influenced What Success Looks Like You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier. What you'll do Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time. Proactive technical advisory: Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence. Technical account planning: Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations. Clinical workflow adoption: Help customers get the full value of what they already own, including secure pull and badge-based printing, serverless print management, and EHR-connected print and document workflows across shared clinical workstations and virtual desktops. Convert unused capability into adoption commitments. Escalation leadership: Lead the technical response when one of your accounts escalates, especially when printing or document delivery touches patient-facing operations. Coordinate Support and Engineering, give the customer one voice, and confirm the fix has held before closing it out. Service delivery and renewal support: Manage entitlement consumption across your book, coordinate Professional Services, Support, and partners, and give Customer Success the technical input needed to protect renewals, quarters ahead. Expansion: Identify new use cases inside the account, such as document workflow and capture needs, and build the technical case with Customer Success and Sales. Field feedback and enablement: Share healthcare field insight with Product and Engineering, and contribute runbooks, health-check templates, and reference architectures to the shared library. What You Bring Strong technical grounding, healthcare IT fluency, and a structured approach to keeping accounts healthy and growing: Post-sales technical advisory: Health reviews, adoption planning, review delivery, escalation coordination, and clear communication from IT administrator to Director level. Architecture and systems thinking: Ability to read and critique a customer's deployment architecture, including multi-site and virtualized environments. Networking and identity: Troubleshooting DNS, proxies, and firewalls; strong grasp of LDAP and SSO (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping), plus badge and tap-to-authenticate workflows such as Imprivata. Security and compliance: Working knowledge of HIPAA and HITECH requirements as they apply to print and output management; awareness of SOC 2 and ISO. Domain expertise: Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them. Technical toolbox: Diagramming; bash and/or PowerShell; SQL basics; RESTful APIs; Jira; AI-assisted workflows. Qualifications Hands-on post-sales experience and the technical depth to earn trust with customer administrators: 3-5+ years in technical account management, post-sales engineering, or senior technical support for SaaS or enterprise software Track record owning enterprise accounts through renewal cycles and escalations Comfortable engaging technical owners and decision makers, with strong writing and presentation skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience English language proficiency; additional language skills valued What Sets You Apart Healthcare instincts that identify risk and opportunity before anyone asks: Experience working inside a hospital or health-system IT organization, or supporting one as a vendor Hands-on exposure to EHR-connected printing, clinical workstation environments, or virtual desktop infrastructure Experience with healthcare compliance reviews and security questionnaires Track record of recovering an at-risk account Early-access or beta program management Benefits Flexible work environment Vacation Bonus Flexible paid time off Paid parental leave Competitive pay A full suite of traditional benefits Training/Advancement opportunities 401k with company match and immediate vesting Financial wellness education Company-contributed HSA On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc. Our Core Values Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become: Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers. Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication. Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly. Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance. More about Vasion Visit to learn more about Vasion . Additional Information Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics. matches.why: Product analyst role in clinical decision software, though it is at a 'Lead' level and requires heavy daily hands-on SQL querying.
matches.d: Help product teams understand how clinicians and care teams engage with UpToDate's clinical decision support products. At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite supports millions of clinical decisions every day. As we continue to evolve our CDS and AI-enabled experiences, we need clear insight into what users engage with, which interactions drive meaningful action, where workflows lose momentum, and how product changes affect adoption and value. As Lead Product Analyst, CDS Adoption & Engagement, you will focus on adoption, engagement, funnel behavior, and usage patterns across clinical decision support products. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Commercial, and customer-facing teams to turn product data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. This is not a reporting-only role. You will be expected to query product usage data directly, investigate patterns, and translate analysis into practical recommendations. What You'll Do Define and maintain adoption, engagement, funnel, and usage metrics for CDS products. Query product usage data to analyze clicks, actions, user journeys, drop-offs, cohorts, segments, and usage patterns. Analyze what users engage with, which interactions drive downstream action, and where workflows lose momentum. Build dashboards and recurring views that help product teams monitor product performance and user behavior. Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics for launches, pilots, MVPs, and experiments. Identify insights that inform roadmap priorities, UX improvements, content needs, commercialization, and adoption strategies. Help improve instrumentation and metric definitions so teams can rely on consistent, high-quality product data. Translate analysis into clear recommendations for product, leadership, commercial, and customer-facing teams. What You'll Bring 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, business analytics, product operations, or a related role. Strong ability to write queries independently using SQL or comparable data-querying tools. Experience analyzing adoption, engagement, funnel metrics, click behavior, cohorts, segments, and usage patterns and generating insights that contribute to the product development strategy. Comfort working with event-level product telemetry, data models, and imperfect instrumentation. Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and actionable insights. Experience building dashboards, recurring reports, or self-serve product analytics views. Strong communication skills and ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Commercial, or Customer Success teams. Preferred Background Experience with healthcare, clinical workflow, enterprise SaaS, AI-enabled products, search, content products, or decision-support tools. Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, product telemetry, event instrumentation, or customer journey analytics. Experience with modern data platforms and business intelligence tools. Experience analyzing qualitative and quantitative feedback together. What Success Looks Like Product teams have clear, trusted metrics for CDS adoption, engagement, funnels, and usage patterns. PMs understand which interactions and workflows drive meaningful user action. Usage analysis identifies opportunities to improve clinician and care team satisfaction, workflow fit, and repeat engagement. Launches and experiments have clear success metrics and post-launch performance visibility. Leadership has a clearer view of how CDS products are being used and where investment is creating value. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. About Campus Kaizen Campus Kaizen, a business unit of Cordance, delivers Guardian Case Management — a purpose-built software platform for K–12 school districts and higher education institutions. Guardian centralizes sensitive case workflows including Title IX, HR, Bullying, Employee Relations, Behavioral Intervention Teams (BIT), Student Conduct, and more, replacing spreadsheets and disconnected systems with secure, compliant processes. matches.t: Technical Program Manager - Data Center Infrastructure Delivery
matches.why: Strong AI cloud infrastructure company, but this TPM role centers on physical construction, MEP, and facility delivery.
matches.d: Lambda , The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. Role Overview Lambda is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own the integrated delivery program for new data center builds, from the handoff of a selected site by Real Estate through construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and turnover to Network Deployment. You will be the single source of truth for milestones, risks, and dependencies on your sites, leading internal teams and external partners (GCs, design firms, utilities, and vendors) across site work, utilities, shell, MEP, controls, white space, inspections, and commissioning. Ambiguity is high, timelines are compressed, and the stakes are central to company growth. As we scale beyond our first sites, you will help build the playbooks and governance that let us run many concurrent deployments well. What You’ll Do Own the integrated schedule from site handoff to Operations; break builds into workstreams with clear owners and milestones, and actively manage the critical path and schedule compression. Drive the delivery sequence from rack requirements to engineering criteria, design, plan set, permitting, construction, commissioning, and turnover for MW-scale, high-density (including liquid-cooled) capacity. Lead cross-functional execution with Real Estate (site assumptions, fiber, permit path), Energy and Utilities (interconnection, substation, power delivery), Engineering (requirements in the design and plan set), Procurement (long-lead equipment), Construction Management (GC schedule, field progress, inspections), Commissioning (test plans, acceptance), Operations (staffing, procedures, access), and Security, and Finance (requirements, budget, CapEx), and Legal. Manage risk and governance: maintain risk registers, dependency logs, decision trackers, and schedule variance reports; surface permitting, utility, design, procurement, sequencing, and commissioning risks early. Escalate with facts: status, baseline vs. forecast date, variance, impact, owner, mitigation options, and decision date. Lead schedule recovery when milestones slip. Hold partners accountable to contractual milestones, production and shipping schedules, and commercial commitments while maintaining productive relationships. Communicate to leadership through program reviews and concise, high-signal status updates. Deliver clean turnover: define handover criteria and ensure white space, power, cooling, controls, cable pathways, access, and documentation are ready for Network Deployment. Scale the function: build repeatable playbooks, dashboards, and lessons-learned loops across concurrent deployments. Travel (~40%) to sites to validate progress and build partner relationships. Scope of Ownership Owns: site-level delivery program management; the integrated schedule; cross-functional coordination; milestone, risk, dependency, and decision tracking; variance reporting and escalation; Operations readiness. Partners on, but does not own: site selection and real estate; engineering design authority; construction means and methods and GC management; commissioning authority; procurement commercial strategy; network and services deployment; steady-state operations. You Have 7+ years in data center delivery, infrastructure or construction program management, mission-critical facilities, or large capital projects. Have delivered ground-up data centers or comparable mission-critical, industrial, semiconductor, or energy facilities, ideally multi-site on compressed timelines. Know the full lifecycle: site handoff, permitting, design, utilities, procurement, construction, MEP, controls, commissioning, and turnover. Run integrated schedules, critical path, dependency logs, and change control with rigor. Understand technical tradeoffs well enough to spot risks, ask precise questions, and escalate without owning design authority. Align partners, vendors, and engineering teams around shared deliverables, and bridge physical infrastructure with network and security teams. Make sound decisions with incomplete information under schedule pressure, and communicate status clearly to executives. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to Have Hyperscale, AI/GPU, cloud region, or high-density compute delivery experience. Utility interconnection, substation, MV/HV power, and liquid cooling experience. Work with colocation providers, GCs, EPCs, commissioning agents, and permitting authorities. PMP, construction management, engineering, or project controls certification. Success Measures Sites reach infrastructure turnover on the committed timeline. Milestones across engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, procurement, and utilities are visible and accurate. Critical path risks are escalated early with a clear owner, impact, and mitigation options. Handoff to Operations meets defined readiness criteria, with no major gaps. Salary Range Information The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. About Lambda Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers We offer generous cash & equity compensation Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees) Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use Equal Opportunity Employer Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees. As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI enabled tools to support certain aspects of hiring, such as interview note-taking. All hiring decisions are made by our team.
